Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-25

Overview

On 2026-11-25 the main branch received 1288 commits, of which 1017 were filtered as relevant to Windows/macOS embedders. The day was dominated by a large batch of public-interface signature changes (proxy policy, tab strip, auth token vault, GCM, HTML serialization, ui::TreeModel), the outright removal of the OOPIF PDF policy, and a broad set of security hardening and startup-performance wins. Range: first commit (b9ad86e) (https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/(b9ad86e)), last commit (3a1d1cd) (https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/(3a1d1cd)).

Breaking Public API Changes

  • ⚠️AreUserProxyOverrideRulesAllowed() signature and scope enforcement changed. The exported two-argument form (const PrefService*, policy::PolicyService*) is replaced by a single policy::PolicyService* argument in components/proxy_config/proxy_prefs_utils.h, so downstream callers fail to build. Behaviorally the EnableProxyOverrideRulesForAllUsers policy must now be POLICY_SCOPE_MACHINE; a user-scoped instance is silently ignored for unaffiliated users, which also affects proxyOverrideRulesPrivate extension modifiability. (57195b3)
    NetworkEnterprisePolicy
  • ⚠️TabStripModelDelegate::MoveToExistingWindow() gains a required std::optional&lt;tab_groups::TabGroupId&gt; parameter. The pure-virtual in chrome/browser/ui/tabs and chrome::MoveTabsToExistingWindow() were updated in-CL; any embedder subclass or caller breaks. Tabs added to a group in another window now insert at the group tail and preserve Focus Mode, and split-tab insertion exits focus mode outside the focused group. (75c5419)
    TabsUIBrowser
  • ⚠️ui::TreeModel traversal surface removed and observation contract tightened. GetChildren(), GetIndexOf(), GetParent() and the Nodes typedef are deleted from the exported ui/base/models/tree_model.h with no deprecation window (consumers must use TreeModelNode accessors). TreeModelObserver now derives from base::CheckedObserver with a check_empty observer list, so destroying a model with live observers CHECK-fails, and the exported NotifyObserverTreeNode*() helpers are gone. (439ecc1) (a210a2f)
    UIBase
  • ⚠️Authentication fetch interfaces changed in two exported headers. TrustedVaultClient::FetchKeys()'s completion callback now yields std::vector<trusted_vault::TrustedVaultKeyAndVersion> instead of a vector of raw keys, forcing updates in every implementation and in SyncServiceCrypto/passkey consumers. In parallel, OAuth2AccessTokenFetcher loses GetNetworkLatency()/GetChallengeSigningLatency() in favor of the new pure-virtual GetLatencies() returning an OAuth2AccessTokenFetcher::Latencies struct, so out-of-tree subclasses and mocks must add the override. (7c75f48) (c5e7f82)
    SyncCryptoPasswordManager
  • ⚠️GCM GCMClient interface split token deletion out of unregistration. A new pure-virtual GCMClient::DeleteToken(InstanceIDTokenInfo, DeleteTokenCallback) is added, Unregister() and Observer::OnUnregisterFinished() are narrowed to GCMRegistrationInfo, and GCMDriverDesktop's IO worker routes through the new method. Any embedder implementing GCMClient or its observer on Windows/macOS must implement the new method and update override signatures. (842be29)
    NetworkNotifications
  • ⚠️PdfViewerOutOfProcessIframeEnabled policy removed outright. The policy is deleted from the configuration policy handler list, the pref and its registration are dropped, chrome_browser_main.cc no longer calls SetIsOopifPdfPolicyEnabled(), and the pdf-oopif flag disappears from about_flags/flag metadata. Policy providers, admin templates and embedders documenting the key must drop it; OOPIF PDF is now unconditional, and the PDF viewer no longer uses the chrome.mimeHandlerPrivate stream-info/save path. (af7679b) (3f37dcc)
    PolicyPDFEnterprise
  • ⚠️HTML serialization moved off content.mojom.Frame onto blink.mojom.LocalFrame. content::mojom::FrameHTMLSerializerHandler, Frame::GetSerializedHtmlWithLocalLinks(), WebFrameSerializerClient, WebFrameSerializer::LinkRewritingDelegate and WebFrameSerializer::Serialize are deleted rather than deprecated, and DidReceiveData becomes a ByteString on a deferrable task type since serialized HTML carries the document encoding. Save-page/serializer integrations must migrate to the Blink mojom interface and re-verify byte-level encoding. (e57687c)
    NavigationBlinkBrowser
  • ⚠️ASSIGN_OR_RETURN/RETURN_IF_ERROR handlers must now return movable types. UnexpectedDeducer invokes the handler eagerly and holds the result by value, so immovable prvalue handler results — previously legal — are a compile error (a nocompile test enforces the contract). References remain references, so base::expected<T, std::string_view> patterns are unaffected. (b585b97)
    Base

Security & Privacy

  • Untrusted-renderer and cross-origin trust boundaries tightened. MediaInterfaceProxy/FramelessMediaInterfaceProxy now ReportBadMessage() instead of CHECK-killing the browser when a renderer passes an already-bound decoder; url::Origin deserialization rejects invalid pickled tuples and CHECKs in the SchemeHostPort constructor; ClipboardHostImpl::ReadFiles() only accepts kCopyPaste (closing a selection-buffer file-name read); and mixed-content reports strip cross-origin URLs to their origin before they reach a cross-origin RenderFrameHost. (b8d3ae8) (2915c95) (5dcedee) (2d55c14)
    SecurityMediaBlink
  • Safe Browsing referrer chains no longer leak unrelated IPs or allowlist remnants. SanitizeReferrerChainEntries() clears ip_addresses unless subframe and main frame share a host (previously a main-frame URL was paired with a third-party subframe IP), RemoveSafeBrowsingAllowlistDomains clears IPs too, is_url_removed_by_policy is evaluated per entry, and consumer Enhanced/Standard-protection users no longer upload server IPs at all — only ESB or enterprise-managed profiles do. (fa24034) (9ecb305) (07f19ae)
    PrivacyNetworkSecurity
  • Crash reports no longer carry UMA identifiers in the system profile. MetricsService::RecordCurrentEnvironment() now hands MetricsServiceClient::OnEnvironmentUpdate() a re-serialized copy with client_uuid, session_hash, fg_bg_id and cloned_install_info cleared via the new MetricsLog::ClearUmaIdentifiers(), closing a leak into the Crashpad environment stream. Logs, prefs and the persistent system profile keep identifiers; custom crash-key or uploader logic that read those fields will see them absent. (e6a1451)
    PrivacyBase
  • WebAuthn privacy and PIN-flow hardening. Silent getAssertion probes now build a minimal CTAP request behind enabled-by-default kWebAuthnOmitExtensionsInSilentGetAssertion (removal planned M163), so largeBlobKey, largeBlob, credBlob, cmtgKey and prf are never sent to pre-flight probes or written prematurely. GPM PIN change is reworked to require OS user verification first (failing closed where OS UV is unavailable) with local PIN hashing/verification isolated in gpm/local_gpm_pin_crypto. (fd45a7f) (600901a) (009c9ea)
    SecurityCryptoPasswordManager
  • Memory-safety fixes across shared code. ScriptPromise now catches and clears pending V8 exceptions from reaction attachment/resolver allocation instead of leaking them into a cross-origin caller frame; HistoryClustersTabHelper::OnUkmNavigationComplete() early-returns and re-checks annotations to fix a use-after-free; SVG SMIL RemoveAnimation() no longer holds a HashMap iterator across a rehash; and BookmarkCodec validates permanent-node dictionaries and bounds persisted IDs to stop a startup crash on corrupt bookmark JSON. (62af73c) (88e8a9c) (d9339ed) (c48a528)
    SecurityBookmarksBlink

Browser & Extension Behavior

  • Extension navigation gating and API reliability changed. OpenTabHelper stops setting initiator_origin for chrome-extension:// (and view-source:-wrapped) targets, fixing extensions opening other extensions' non-web-accessible pages — but another extension's blob:/filesystem: URLs are now blocked (kill switch ExtensionOpenTabSetInitiatorOrigin). runtime.onExtensionLoaded now waits for an unstarted MV3 worker on startup/browser_update/reload so persisted listeners are not dropped, pageCapture.saveAsMHTML() acks after a blob-pipe round trip to fix a NotFoundError race, and getDynamicRules() serialization can move off the UI thread for large rule sets. (0e626bc) (eeed800) (9cc1ea5) (0929fa5)
    ExtensionsNavigationPerformance
  • DevTools protocol behavior changes for automation. Attaching to a tab target no longer loads a discarded or session-restore-pending tab; main-frame navigation throttles make waitForDebuggerOnStart pause browser-initiated loads, and Target.activateTarget is what loads discarded tabs (harnesses relying on attach-triggers-load must adjust). Also: BiDi adds an optional aclHandler and a proper browserName/dotted browserVersion, additive Network.Request.adProvenance, and LayerTree.loadSnapshot is restricted to the outermost main frame. (548591b) (bd8f641) (323d90b) (f4aac72)
    DevToolsTesting
  • WebUI toolbar and omnibox behavior adjusted. LocationBarElement tracks DOM focus separately from Views focus so remembered omnibox focus survives tab switches (BrowserFocusTest.TabsRememberFocus), the WebUI toolbar lazy_load.js split is reverted so controls are present in the first painted frame, and the WebUI toolbar opts into crash-on-JS-error only in non-official builds. Menu/focus edge cases also fixed: AIM popup blur clears edit-model focus, and ChroMenu per-word search bolding works for out-of-order multi-word queries. (ecfce42) (3c11976) (1fec900)
    UIBrowser
  • --app=&lt;url&gt; now resolves into an installed web app and launches asynchronously. On desktop, a URL inside an installed web app's scope opens in a new window of that app (with matching window identity/grouping) instead of a plain app window, via the new web_app::startup::HandleWebAppLaunchByUrl(). Because the registry may still be loading, the window can appear after StartupBrowserCreator returns — launch harnesses need the same waits added to AppModeTest and AppControllerWebAppBrowserTest. (1678d84)
    BrowserUINavigation

Performance & Startup

  • Startup main-thread work reduced. HistoryServiceFactory defers backend init to first window first presentation (fixing blank NTP favicons) with measured BrowserWindow.FirstPaint −5.5 ms and FirstWebContents.NonEmptyPaint3 −26.5 ms, and DowngradeManager returns early when the recorded last version equals the current one, skipping macOS OpenDirectory XPC / Windows domain and Azure AD queries on every warm start (ReloadButton.FCP −2.0 ms). (959e9d3) (14a5582)
    PerformanceHistoryBrowser
  • Page-load and menu-open latency wins. Bundled V8 code caching for chrome://new-tab-page/ (behind kWebUIBundledCodeCacheForNewTabPage) reports NTP load startup −32 ms cold / −36 ms warm on Linux and −19 / −17.5 ms on macOS Apple silicon. The Cocoa History menu is lazily populated behind kHistoryMenuOptimizations, dropping TabRestoreServiceChanged() from 135 ms to 0.21 ms and session load from 137 ms to 0.24 ms for large restored sessions. (f1d384f) (2adfc18)
    PerformancemacOSUI
  • Algorithmic and decode hot-path improvements. Bookmark lookups gain an IdIndex (BookmarkModel::GetNodeById()) so GetBookmarkNodeByID() is O(1) instead of a recursive DFS, removing quadratic behavior in extension batch operations, WebUI PathOps and undo. Read Anything's suffix-array construction switches to prefix doubling, turning a 2.5 s case on a 100k-character page into a fast path with identical output. (948ff69) (7c032c8)
    PerformanceBookmarksUI
  • Memory pressure and binary-size wins. TransferBuffer::AllocateRingBuffer() retries smaller shared-memory sizes with kReturnNullOnOOM before the final minimum-size attempt, so GLES2/raster/WebGPU contexts survive transient shm pressure instead of being lost. Several large static tables (sync DataType lookup, metrics CRX-ID map, Google/YouTube TLD sets, Blink legacy TLD table) move from .data.rel.ro to .rodata, removing hundreds of dynamic ELF relocations from the startup path. (6ae0cca) (ec54826) (7555976)
    PerformanceGPUBase

Platform, GPU & Media

  • Windows GPU composition and device-loss handling. Graphite CopyOutput now flushes the Dawn D3D11 backend when readbacks or texture-completion callbacks are pending, eliminating 250–1000 ms stalls on DirectComposition overlay frames. The D3D11 depth-clear driver-bug entry was reworked (graphite_d3d11_depth_clear_is_buggy plus use_draw_for_buggy_depth_clear), and enabled-by-default kAlwaysExitOnContextLost forces a GPU-process restart on context loss on all platforms rather than only with the passthrough decoder. (96a451e) (35976ee)
    GPUWindowsCompositor
  • Media pipeline correctness fixes. GetMediaFoundationCdmData's mojom reply is made nullable so a failed per-origin CDM directory/ACL setup no longer dereferences null in the browser process (kGetCdmPrefDataFailed path). Mp2tStreamParser::HasUnparsedData() now reports trailing TS bytes, incomplete PSI sections and incomplete PES headers so segment-based demuxers can validate boundaries, and on-device translation adds per-origin input budgets plus disk/metered/DataSaver download gating with new error values. (dd5e76a) (4bcdb4c) (594c660) (b81ddf8)
    MediaAINetwork

Build, Test & Downstream Infrastructure

  • Downstream test and build surface changes embedders must absorb. The PSL test hooks are replaced by nesting-safe ScopedFindDomainGraphForTesting; PrivacySandboxAttestationsMixin and its GN target plus StateKey::kAttestationsMap test state are deleted; BubbleDialogDelegate::set_shadow() is removed (use set_shadow_config() before widget creation); SetOnDragStartedCallbackForTesting() is gone in favor of a real observer list; WeakWrapperSharedURLLoaderFactory loses its DanglingUntriaged annotation so wrappers must outlive or Detach() the factory; and re-entrant GetServiceForContext() calls now trip a check that becomes fatal at M165 for non-Blink embedders. checkdeps was rewritten (60.1 s → 10.7 s on chrome/browser) and gn_check_generated is enforced on linux-rel, which can surface pre-existing include violations as new build failures. (aa97039) (683770e) (ae6bd55) (a222ed5) (f5002c8) (cf34b53)
    BuildTestingInfra
  • Cross-arch V8 snapshot toolchains no longer treated as targets. toolchain_for_v8_snapshot = true on clang_x64_v8_arm64/clang_arm64_v8_x64 excludes them from is_a_target_toolchain unless explicitly the default_toolchain, preventing the host-only snapshot generator from inheriting ThinLTO/PGO/CFI (measured 4.9× faster generator links, −31% clean build). Embedders overriding custom_toolchain must still select the snapshot toolchain as default or lose the gains; the thinlto_optimize_none experiment was added and then reverted after an AArch64 ObjC-intrinsic link failure. (e24979e)
    BuildInfra

2026-11-23

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-23

Overview

On 2026-11-23 the main branch received 939 commits (705 relevant to embedders and platform developers), spanning the range from (1bd6be2) to (bf8bca4). The day was dominated by security and reliability hardening (libvpx VP9 overflow fix, libxml2/libxslt allocation checks, DevTools snapshot deserialization, OTR network isolation, credential-prompt privacy), by two genuine embedder-facing API breaks (CDP Target.createTarget scoping and the removal of RenderFrameHost::DocumentUsedWebOTP() plus its AutofillDriver virtual), and by a cluster of Windows/macOS windowing and toolbar fixes plus a Windows startup CPU-probe removal and an anti-aliasing revert that recovered a 14% FCP regression.

Breaking Changes & API Removals

  • ⚠️BREAKING: CDP Target.createTarget is now scoped to the session's BrowserContext. Non-Browser sessions reject browserContextId with InvalidParams ("browserContextId is only allowed for Browser target") instead of falling back to the last-used profile, and the target is resolved from DevToolsAgentHost::GetBrowserContext() (ServerError if unresolvable). The public content::TargetHandler constructor's DevToolsAgentHostClientChannel* parameter also lost its = nullptr default. Affects CDP drivers, DevTools frontends and chrome.debugger clients. (b2c9526)
    DevToolsBrowser
  • ⚠️BREAKING: content::RenderFrameHost::DocumentUsedWebOTP() is deleted outright with no deprecation shim, and the pure-virtual autofill::AutofillDriver::DocumentUsedWebOtp() is removed from the interface — any embedder with a custom AutofillDriver fails to compile. The flag now lives per-document in AutofillManager, surfaced through the new WebContentsObserver::OnDocumentUsedWebOtp(RenderFrameHost*), and is cleared in AutofillManager::Reset() rather than on RenderFrameHost navigation, so RFH-lifetime reset assumptions must be re-reviewed. (29ae0ec)
    AutofillBrowser
  • Long-deprecated page-load-metric observer APIs were removed: RenderFrame::SetLoadFromMemoryCacheCallback, RenderFrameObserver::DidLoadResourceFromMemoryCache(GURL, …), OnMainFrameRectangleChanged, OnMainFrameViewportRectangleChanged, DidObserveFirstScrollDelay, the matching WebLocalFrameClient virtuals, and WebLocalFrameObserver::OnMainFrameAdRectangleChanged. Replacements live on blink::WebLocalFrameMetricsObserver; out-of-tree code that overrides the old methods will fail to compile. (115880b)
    BlinkBrowser
  • Authenticated Proxy-auto-discovery proxies must now be HTTPS: non-HTTPS 407 challenges from PvD proxies are classified kNotApplicable (non_https_challenger), FetchProxyAuthCredentials() gained CHECK(proxy_server.is_https()), and PvD configs advertising google_chrome.auth over plain HTTP are rejected with the proxy IDs pruned from match rules (explicit DIRECT preserved). Enterprise deployments using plain-HTTP authenticated PvD proxies must change configuration; not flag-gated. (6af503b)
    NetworkEnterprise

Security & Privacy

  • libvpx rolled to 02afbb3db including the security fix "vp9: Fix pending_frame_sizes overflow in SVC bypass mode" (out-of-bounds access in the VP9 SVC pending-frame array), plus AVX2 highbd comp_avg_pred, AVX2 8-bit/highbd temporal filter, and AVX2 highbd block_error/sum_squares. vpx_version.h and the RTCD headers were regenerated for all configs. (9924997)
    MediaSecurity
  • libxml2/libxslt memory-safety hardening: XsltUnicodeSortFunction now treats ucol_getFunctionalEquivalent()'s U_STRING_NOT_TERMINATED_WARNING (invisible to U_FAILURE()) as a fallback-to-"root" signal so the resolved locale name is always NUL-terminated, and xsltAddTextString validates xmlNodeAddContent results and requires a non-null, exclusively owned ctxt->lasttext before the coalescing fast path reallocates. (4e843a8) (a1d8363)
    SecurityBase
  • DevTools layer snapshots are hardened during deserialization: PictureSnapshot::DeserializePicture() configures SkDeserialProcs to disable SkSL runtime effects, resolves descriptor-only typefaces via skia::DefaultFontMgr() while rejecting embedded typeface streams, and validates replaySnapshot/profileSnapshot step/scale/repeat/duration arguments with gfx::RectF::IsFinite(), int32-overflow→empty bounds and CheckedNumeric-sized tryAllocPixels. Shader- or typeface-heavy snapshots may render with reduced fidelity. (9c85f2e)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • Off-the-record Safe Browsing traffic now uses an isolated in-memory NetworkContext: HashRealTimeServiceFactory and OhttpKeyServiceFactory bind with use_same_instance_in_off_the_record=false, giving OTR HPRT/OHTTP its own socket pools, TLS session and host caches so it cannot be correlated with regular-profile traffic (small extra memory per OTR profile). Separately, PKIMetadata/PKIMetadataFastpush are now security-critical and keep updating even when ComponentUpdatesEnabled=false, deliberately overriding that policy. (6dc764b) (cedd90f)
    NetworkSecurityPrivacy
  • Credential/permission prompt privacy hardening: the WebAuthn ambient bubble now opens unfocused (a bit plumbed from ChipController) so a page cannot infer credential availability from the blur event, while chip-initiated openings still focus; the Trusted Vault unlock prompt validates the requesting subframe origin (permitting same-origin about:blank) so embedded opaque/Google frames on external sites can no longer surface it; and COEP/COOP reports stop leaking nextResponseURL on history/restore/reload navigations. (1d5944f) (01f1fcd) (fe2aa0b)
    PrivacySecurityPasswordManager

Networking & Storage

  • The HTTP cache now treats Vary: Authorization as Vary: *: HttpVaryData::Init()/MatchesRequest() route through HandleAsVaryStar() because authorization headers are not visible at the cache layer. Authenticated responses are therefore never reused from the cache and always revalidate over the network, including under LOAD_SKIP_CACHE_VALIDATION (new LoadSkipCacheValidationVaryAuth test expects 2 network transactions). Spec-correct (RFC 7234 §4.1) but a real change in request counts for authenticated resources. (7184423)
    NetworkStorage
  • WebRTC log-list handling is hardened and a shutdown hang is fixed: shared TextLogList::ReadLogListFile()/WriteLogListFile() open Log List with O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK and require a regular file via fstat(), so a named pipe can no longer block open() forever on the background sequence and, with a running task, prevent the browser from exiting. Pipes/symlinks are replaced atomically, directories skipped, and a single 1 MB cap now applies in both callers. (8f1b619)
    WebRTCNetwork
  • SimpleCache enumeration no longer recurses once per failed entry: OpenNextEntry uses a single ref-counted completion callback instead of re-wrapping per retry, reducing completion stack depth from O(n) to O(1) and eliminating per-attempt allocations. A regression test drives 600 missing entries on a 128 KiB thread stack. (64d708e)
    NetworkStorage

Extensions, Enterprise & Policy

  • New extension API chrome.sidebar.getLayout(): adds a Side enum, PanelLayout dictionary and getLayout() in sidebar.webidl, implemented as SidebarGetLayoutFunction over SidePanelService::GetSidePanelLayout() (mapping left/right sides) plus a SIDEBAR_GETLAYOUT histogram. Additive and behind the ApiSidebar flag on the trunk channel. (b01561e)
    ExtensionsUI
  • The bundled Hangouts component extension is no longer loaded by default: kRemoveHangoutsExtension flipped from FEATURE_DISABLED_BY_DEFAULT to FEATURE_ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT in component_loader.cc. Flag-controlled removal of a deprecated component — no API surface change. (2d36cb7)
    Extensions
  • Enterprise policy updates: DefaultSearchProviderSearchURLPostParams/SuggestURLPostParams are deprecated (supported through M160) and documented as having always been no-ops — only ImageURLPostParams is honored — so configs relying on POST search/suggest semantics should be corrected; ClearBrowsingDataJob and RotateAttestationCredentialJob override RemoteCommandJob::IsExpired() with 24-hour/2-year deadlines instead of the 10-minute default; and IsolatedModeForceInstalledExtensionsSettings lets admins make force-installed Isolated Mode extensions user-disableable. (48b5268) (6aea217) (5946ef2)
    PolicyEnterprise
  • Screenshot-restriction enforcement was reverted out of chrome.tabCapture: TabCaptureCaptureFunction and TabCaptureGetMediaStreamIdFunction no longer call ExtensionsBrowserClient::IsScreenshotRestricted(), since TabCaptureAccessHandler::HandleRequest() already enforces CheckScreenShareRestriction() at start and continuously tracks navigations, and ScreenCaptureAllowed/TabCaptureAllowedByOrigins still gate capture. Restores the prior stable policy boundary and fixes audio-only captures plus DLP WARN rules being hard-blocked without a dialog. (931da2e)
    ExtensionsEnterprisePrivacy

Browser UI — Windows & macOS

  • DefaultBrowserMonitor on Windows 11 now also watches the permanent UrlAssociations\{http,https} parent keys via the new DefaultBrowserMonitorUrlAssociations feature (enabled by default as a kill switch), because modern Windows writes association updates into UserChoiceLatest subkeys without touching legacy UserChoice. The monitor re-arms immediately on change, upgrades a watcher that was missing at StartMonitor(), and coalesces subtree write bursts with a 400 ms trailing debounce. (7be9e8f)
    WindowsBrowser
  • macOS WebUI toolbar: control+click is now treated as a right-click (isOnlyLeftClick() ignores it) across the app menu, location icon, overflow, split tabs, glic actor task icon, permission_chip.ts and webui_toolbar.ts, and MenuSourceType classification was fixed so right-click/Ctrl+Click no longer report kKeyboard (pointer events and mousemove always have detail == 0; contextmenu is classified by button). The location bar is deliberately unchanged because it regressed word selection. (6c1853e) (868add8)
    macOSUI
  • Window bounds/lifetime fixes on both platforms: DesktopWindowTreeHostWin::SetBoundsInDIP() now converts to pixels before clamping against the same limits OnGetMinMaxInfo() applies, fixing oversized client areas at fractional scale (a 201×101 DIP minimum produced 303×154 px instead of 302×152 at 1.5x); macOS normalizes non-positive -[NSWindow windowNumber] (session teardown) to kCGNullWindowID, skips ScopedCGWindowID creation for it, and verifies map-entry ownership before erasing — fixing a std::map::erase(end()) crash during compositor teardown. (b2a0232) (350e067)
    WindowsmacOSUI
  • DesktopNativeWidgetAura now gates host activation on content: it no longer activates its content window or restores focus when its WindowTreeHost gains/loses activation while a sibling (window-modal dialog, Aura child widget) still holds it, and kWindowActivated/kWindowDeactivated a11y events plus OnNativeWidgetActivationChanged() fire only for content-window activation. Also clears a lingering non-modal sibling on asynchronous Activate() and guards against synchronous CLIENT_OWNS_WIDGET destruction (potential UAF). (9a8a6fb)
    UIWindowsmacOS
  • Omnibox Everywhere no longer hardcodes Google branding: OmniboxEverywhereHandler::GetSearchEngineInfo() computes the active DSE's localized placeholder and light/dark icon paths from GetDefaultSearchProviderIcon() (null when no DSE), seeds them into loadTimeData at data-source creation to avoid a loupe flash on cold start, and pushes SetSearchEngineInfo over Mojo on construction and TemplateURLService changes. No visible change in Chrome-branded builds where Google is the required DSE. (e30e77d)
    UIBrowser

Performance & GPU

  • Reverted the anti-aliased CustomCornersBackground split after Pinpoint showed first-contentful-paint regressing 297.2 → 339.6 ms (+14%) on win-arm64-snapdragon-elite-perf: up to four non-convex kDifference clips required GPU raster clip masks. Paint() is back to a single anti-aliased background path (GetBackgroundPath) and the now-unused //skia///ui/compositor test deps were dropped. The 1px fractional-scale seam bug remains open. (071408e)
    PerformanceWindowsUI
  • PageResourceMonitor dropped its own system_cpu::CpuProbe and computes per-tab CPU proportions directly via CPUProportionTracker, because a second concurrent CpuProbeWin during Windows startup contended on pdh.dll!GetMachine and ntdll!LdrpLoaderLock with CpuHealthTracker. The public constructor changed from PageResourceMonitor(bool enable_system_cpu_probe = true) to PageResourceMonitor() — out-of-tree callers passing an argument must update. (ec3ff62)
    PerformanceWindowsBrowser
  • zune-jpeg PR526 backport boxes ScanPlan header snapshots instead of copying them between MCU stripes, with unchanged checkpoint contents and retry behavior. Measured decode CPU: −2.72% (4:4:4), −2.17% (4:4:0), −1.58% (4:2:2), −0.04% (4:2:0). (d40041b)
    PerformanceMedia
  • GPU/compositor correctness work: a per-program link counter now travels through ProgramInfoManager, the passthrough wire format and GLES2CmdDecoderPassthrough replies so reflection data from a superseded link can no longer populate a re-created client cache (previously could undersize stack buffers for uniform queries), and SendEarlyFinalBeginMainFrame is re-enabled in cc/base/features.cc after the re-entrancy fix, with cc/scheduler blocking early BeginMainFrame once the frame source is disconnected. (f40e9e0) (b409bb1) (beffee1)
    GPUCompositor

2026-11-22

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-22

Overview

This batch spans 38 commits (first: (86ae675), last: (bbbfd3d)). Twenty were retained for Windows/macOS embedders (chrome/browser, ui, and testing utilities); the rest are Linux/X11/GTK, Android, iOS, ChromeOS, translation dumps, and flake markings that are out of scope. No commit in this batch is a confirmed breaking change to a stable, embedder-facing public API: the two removal candidates — Blink's test-only WebElement::ShadowRoot() and the already-defaulted MetricsServiceClient::GetProfileCountryIdForPrivateMetricsReporting() hook — have no production embedder dependencies.

Security & Privacy

  • Credential leakage in bug-report logs fixed. CalculateKeyValue was printing raw Google API keys and OAuth client secrets at VLOG(1) for values sourced from environment variables, GAIA config, CLI switches, and default_if_unset — a real exposure since --enable-logging --v=1 is routine in attached logs. The three runtime overrides now emit a redacted preview via RedactKeyValue() (prefix/suffix plus length for ≥16 printable ASCII chars, [empty]/[redacted, len=N] otherwise) while default_if_unset omits the value entirely; redaction still distinguishes overrides for developers. (79f27fe)
    SecurityPrivacy
  • Autofill stops leaking across V8 worlds through closed shadow roots. form_autofill_util.cc now filters closed-shadow-hidden DOM elements out of AutofillEvents, enforcing Shadow DOM encapsulation so element handles and autofilled values cannot cross world boundaries. A companion Blink cleanup collapses the duplicate WebElement::ShadowRoot() into OpenOrClosedShadowRoot() (now const); the removed accessor was used only by in-tree tests and the replacement is semantically equivalent for non-null elements, so third-party callers need at most a one-line change. (2aca3e5) (198d512)
    AutofillBlinkSecurity
  • Windows clipboard no longer CHECK-fails on malformed drag streams. A drag source can advertise TYMED_ISTREAM without an actual IStream*, previously tripping a CHECK in clipboard_util_win.cc when Chrome read file contents. The missing stream is now treated as a failed read with the medium marked TYMED_NULL before release; filename handling and valid-stream paths are unchanged (fixes 583454016). (a6d88ab)
    WindowsUISecurity

Browser UI (Windows/macOS)

  • WebUI toolbar now matches Views for back/forward mouse buttons. These buttons were reaching toolbar WebUI buttons as ordinary clicks, triggering reloads or inverted navigation. webui_toolbar_web_view.cc intercepts them in PreHandleMouseEvent() so they never reach the page, and on Windows forwards the matching APPCOMMAND to ExecuteWindowsCommand() — reproducing Views behavior where the unhandled event becomes WM_APPCOMMAND and navigates the active tab. On macOS the buttons now do nothing, also matching Views; the toolbar still takes focus on these clicks (crbug.com/519327032). (c16e2cb)
    UIBrowserWindows
  • All page actions now carry a unique element_identifier; the location-bar anchoring fallback is gone. Page actions without an identifier were never registered with ElementTracker, so CreateAndShowAnchoredMessage() anchored to kLocationBarElementId instead of the icon — unlike Views PageActionView. Identifiers were added for Lens overlay, Glic contextual cueing, anchored contextual cue, and the debug fake action; uniqueness is now compile-time enforced and the null filtering in GetAllElementIdentifiers() was removed. Anchored IPH/bubble placement for these actions visibly moves from the omnibox to the respective icon. (464d953)
    UIBrowser
  • Full WebUI omnibox popup can be shared across a profile's windows (flag-gated). Under OmniboxWebUIPopupShareAcrossWindows, OmniboxPopupFullPresenter joins a shared pool, skips its constructor-time load when another window holds a full popup, and adopts an idle one on show or window activation; because the popup only displays once its page is ready, Show() cannot create it and the presenter instead requests one from OmniboxPopupWebUIPoolClient, waiting while a peer's popup loads and creating its own only when the shared popup is busy or closed. Only the last-activated window claims a shared ready popup, and "idle" excludes drafts, pending ClearPopup() replies, and pending context-menu requests. kWebUISearchboxWithoutModelController keeps per-window behavior. (4dd6eb7)
    BrowserUI
  • Content-area layout skips redundant work during animations. ContentsContainerView and ContentsContainerOutline avoid needless mini-toolbar and outline updates during layout, targeting smoother side-panel and vertical-tabs transitions (Bug 501743908). (0ace792)
    UIPerformance

Performance

  • Menu hit-testing and tooltip lookup now binary-search instead of scanning every item. SubmenuView previously ran the default linear child scan for event targeting on every pointer move, even though Layout() already stacks visible children top to bottom. Layout() now caches visible children and TargetForRect() (via a ViewTargeter) plus GetTooltipHandlerForPoint() binary-search that cache by y; the cache is invalidated on child add/remove/show/hide and left empty — falling back to base implementations — when a child has a layer or its own targeter. Measured on a 900-item bookmarks-bar overflow menu: UI-thread CPU for a pointer sweep drops 440 ms → 140 ms and hover-highlight lag drops 462 px → 78 px. Internal, but a large responsiveness win for large menus on every platform. (86ae675)
    UIPerformance

Bug Fixes & Stability

  • Glic no longer holds a dangling BrowserWindowInterface. GlicWebClientHandler keeps GlicToolsHolder alive across browser-window lifetimes (notably when Glic is detached into a floating window), but CreateAiOverlayToolsForGlic resolved the active browser once at Mojo pipe creation and stored a raw_ptr<BrowserWindowInterface> on AiOverlayTools — a MiraclePtr dangling-pointer crash whenever that initial window closed while Glic stayed open. A BrowserResolver overload on AiOverlayTools::Create() (plus RegisterBrowserDidClose() subscription for fixed-browser callers) now resolves the most recently activated normal browser window per tool call. (fc72ab7)
    AIBrowser
  • WebAudio stops re-querying a failed output device and now surfaces the failure. On authorization failure or timeout during RendererWebAudioDeviceImpl construction, HandleDeviceStatus() called Stop() and cleared sink_, so the next MaybeCreateSinkAndGetStatus() recreated the sink and issued a second blocking GetOutputDeviceInfo() on the main thread. The status is cached in sink_status_ and returned without recreation (a stopped working device keeps OK so it can reopen; Start() still reopens asynchronously and failures surface via OnRenderError()). Consequently AudioContext({sinkId}) and setSinkId() report the initial error instead of silently retrying against placeholder params, and WebAudio.AudioDestination.OutputDeviceStatus records the cached value. (f69fee8)
    Media
  • Autofill field-type inference moved to LanguageTag. determine_possible_field_types.cc and its vote-upload path now consume LanguageTag rather than raw locale strings, aligning inference with the rest of the autofill language pipeline (Bug 40100455). Internal behavior only; no public API or feature-flag surface changed. (1dee991)
    Autofill

Embedder API Surface

  • Private-metrics country hook removed from MetricsServiceClient (not breaking). PUMA was discontinued and PumaService deleted, so GetProfileCountryIdForPrivateMetricsReporting(), CountryAccessReason::kPrivateUserMetricsReporting, the PumaService friend declaration in CountryAccessKey, and ChromeMetricsServiceClient::cached_profile_ (plus the now-unneeded regional_capabilities includes) were removed. This is a genuine removal rather than a deprecation, but the base class supplied a non-pure default returning std::nullopt, so no embedder was required to override it — it is marked non-breaking because no production code path depended on the hook after PUMA shutdown. (345928a)
    PrivacyBaseProfiles

Testing & Developer Infrastructure

  • Public Transit conditions now evaluate live active Stations. ActivityExistsInNewTaskCondition previously snapshotted the active Stations' task ids in its constructor; it now re-checks on every evaluation, skipping the owning Station (which only becomes active after its Transition completes). This removes the TripBuilder.complete() workaround of calling requireToBeInNewTask() right before the Trigger runs, unblocking reusable end-state descriptions for Transition v3. Because the live check now sees Stations created inside a Trigger, TabStripDragDropTestBase starts its second window directly instead of via MultiWindowTestHelper.createNewChromeTabbedActivity(); six other test classes migrated from ChromeTabUtils#newTabFromMenu() to CtaPageStation#openNewTabFast(), several of them already @DisabledTest. (a76a871) (e298d6d)
    TestingAndroid
  • Test-harness helpers and a Settings WebUI flake fix. Adds CreateAndActivateAutofillDriver() to WithTestAutofillClientDriverManager as a shorthand for create-then-activate, migrating roughly a dozen unit tests. Separately, SettingsTest.GeicSubpage now uses TestPrefsBrowserProxy and resets PrefService, eliminating a race where an async onPrefsChanged(false) from SettingsPrivateEventRouter overwrote a just-clicked toggle value. (21a62fd) (bbbfd3d)
    TestingAutofill
  • Mechanical source cleanups with no behavior change. typedef declarations were replaced with using aliases across ui/base, chrome/browser/ui, and components/feature_engagement per modernize-use-using; unused variables were deleted in chrome/browser/ui to enable a new libc++ warning mode. Embedders forked from these trees will see compile-only churn. (8202fe3) (9552862)
    BaseUIBuild
  • SuperSize viewer gains CSV export of filtered symbols. The HTML binary-size viewer can now copy small filtered symbol sets to the clipboard or download larger ones as a file for spreadsheet/script analysis (Bug 40877406) — tooling only, no shipped binary impact. (8b81b59)
    InfraBuild
  • Routine churn: translation dumps, flake markings, and an AVD bump. Four XTB dumps regenerated from .GRD sources, four TestExpectations entries marking chronically flaky webdriver/WPT tests (take_screenshot, set_network_conditions/contexts.py, continue_response/invalid.py, spin-by-blocking-style-sheet.html) as [ Failure Pass ] on Linux/Debug, and the Android 17 desktop AVD image moved from r1 (CLE3.260929.004) to r2 (CLE3.260929.007). (383aee6) (1de97ed) (f0a8092) (c093eef) (32a38ec) (8d393b6) (7bdc190) (edaa5db) (d51997d)
    I18nTestingInfra

2026-11-21

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-21

Overview

On 2026-11-21, 382 commits landed on the main branch, of which 166 were relevant to Chromium embedders and web developers working on Windows and macOS. The day mixed hard public-API removals in //base, cookie privacy enforcement, Bluetooth serial permission hardening, enterprise proxy error redirection, macOS omnibox fixes, and WebNN/WebAuthn plumbing. First commit: (14f4be7); last commit: (59b4060).

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️base::MemoryPressureListener, MemoryPressureListenerRegistry, MockMemoryPressureListener, RegisteredMockMemoryPressureListener, and the whole base/memory/memory_pressure_listener*.h/.cc header set are deleted from the base component (~962 deletions across 18 files). This is a hard removal, not a deprecation — any embedder including the header or overriding OnMemoryPressure(MemoryPressureLevel) stops compiling and must migrate to base::MemoryConsumer. (99e76b6)
    Base
  • ⚠️base::i18n::CreateTransliteratorFromRules(id, rules) is removed now that callers use CreateTransliterator() with pre-baked und-t-und-x0-* BCP-47-T IDs. transliterator.{h,cc} are additionally moved behind !is_cronet_build in base/BUILD.gn. Same CL fixes an LSan leak, cxx FFI out-of-bounds reads via StringViewToRustSlice/RustStrToStringView, and inverted Hira-Kana/Kana-Hira aliases. (6e04465)
    BaseI18n
  • ⚠️CookieSettingsBase::GetStorageAccessStatus() gains a mandatory bool is_storage_access_potentially_allowed parameter (no default), propagated through URLLoaderFactoryParams, TrustedUrlRequestParams, CorsURLLoaderFactory, CorsURLLoader, and NetworkContext::GetRestrictedCookieManager(). Behavior is unchanged today (all in-tree callers pass true, enforcement is flag-gated), but out-of-tree callers and overriders must update. (ca0280d)
    NetworkPrivacy

Security & Privacy

  • Clear-on-exit now also deletes partitioned cookies when their partition's top-level site is session-only, closing a real privacy leak where a third-party cookie from an allowed domain embedded on a session-only site survived restart. net::SQLitePersistentCookieStore::DeleteAllInList gains a top_frame_site_keys parameter (empty keys never match, so unpartitioned cookies are untouched), and CookieManager::DeleteSessionOnlyCookies applies the same predicate on startup. Gated by network::features::kClearPartitionedCookiesOnExitByTopLevelSite, enabled by default (kill switch available). (cfd48e2)
    NetworkPrivacyStorage
  • Bluetooth permission hardening: Web Serial now stores and verifies the canonical 128-bit service class UUID so a persistent Bluetooth serial grant scoped to a MAC address no longer grants access to all services on that device (legacy grants are intentionally invalidated and must be re-granted). WebBluetoothServiceImpl::RequestScanningStart() was missing the GetBluetoothAllowed() gate and now returns early before any prompt. Separately, the dangerous should_unbond_on_error flag is dropped from ConnectToServiceInsecurely / adapter.mojom, so a failed RFCOMM connect can no longer unbond a paired keyboard, mouse, or headset. (5c7518a) (b5d347e) (53964c8)
    BluetoothSecurityPrivacy
  • Reader Mode / web-distiller Mojo hardening: BindDistillerJavaScriptService now requires no outer document, a committed origin scheme of chrome-distiller://, and a committed URL scheme of chrome-distiller:// (primary-frame violations get ReportBadMessage), the service is re-scoped to the document lifetime via content::DocumentService, and kMinFontScale is raised 0.4 → 0.5 with non-finite/out-of-range scales rejected end-to-end. (64a9d6c)
    SecurityBrowserPrivacy
  • Site isolation: unassigned SiteInstances no longer inherit initiator origins. Empty document schemes other than about: (e.g. chrome-native:) that never assign a site now get an opaque origin with no precursor, plus a CHECK that nothing committed in an unassigned SiteInstance carries one — a step toward disallowing committed origins in unused ProcessLocks. (89fa0a4)
    SecurityNavigation
  • Hybrid post-quantum variations seed signing: pins three ECDSA P-256 + ML-DSA-44 keys, advertises them via a new X-Seed-Key-Ids request header, reuses X-Seed-Signature with a <key_id>:<base64> prefix, verifies via BoringSSL, and on the first valid new-key seed sets variations_legacy_seed_key_distrusted in Local State to reject subsequent legacy-only seeds. Legacy signatures remain accepted during transition, so no embedder action is required today. (a00ee1e)
    NetworkSecurityCrypto

Networking & Enterprise

  • Enterprise 407 url= static error-page redirect: primary main-frame navigations hitting a disguised-error 407 from a configured HTTPS enterprise proxy now redirect to the challenge's validated https:// url= param via a clean browser-initiated GET (empty Referrer, no POST body, opaque initiator → Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site, SameSite=Strict cookies withheld, Back history preserved). Hardened with strict RFC token validation, duplicate param/header rejection, HTTPS-only enforcement, and a one-hop loop cap. Gated by enable_static_error_page_redirect on EnterpriseProxyErrorHandling. (cb20f3e)
    EnterpriseNetworkSecurity
  • ResourceRequest gains an optional content_user_agent field (mojom traits, EqualsForTesting, PrefetchMatches) used by the network service only when no explicit UA header is present; CORS preflights take the UA from this field when kAllowUserAgentHeaderFromScript is on. CorsURLLoaderFactory::IsValidRequest() rejects the field with ReportBadMessage while the feature is off and truncates to 512 bytes with a NetworkService.ContentUserAgentSize histogram. Feature disabled by default and nothing sets the field yet, so zero behavior change. (13a1f52)
    Network
  • WebTransport: a peer closing with WT_CLOSE_SESSION + FIN that also STOP_SENDINGs the CONNECT stream now signals a clean close without requiring both FINs, so the session no longer transitions to FAILED via OnConnectStreamAborted() before OnSessionClosed() can reach CLOSED. Covers both frame orders and the symmetric peer-reset case. (6437a2a)
    Network

Browser UI & UX

  • macOS: the Full WebUI omnibox popup reshow is now deferred until the host window is on-screen. Previously, reopening the popup for an unfocused fullscreen draft while the window sat on another Space rendered it over an unrelated window. ReshowPopup() queries its host, and OmniboxPopupFullPresenter defers and reopens on return (workaround removable once crbug.com/588536651 is fixed). (1288653)
    macOSUI
  • Browser::OnActiveTabChanged() now populates active global infobars before BrowserWindow::OnActiveTabChanged() swaps InfoBarContainer's manager, eliminating the 0px container collapse and the second WebContents reflow that previously happened on every tab switch. ShowGlobally() activation order now uses a FIFO vector instead of sorting by InfoBarIdentifier. (dd9b015)
    UITabsPerformance
  • The Trusted Types Checker (TTC) overlay now prompts for a Gemini API key after the built-in default key was removed from internal resources: it adds InitializationState.NEEDS_API_KEY with an inline password input, persists the key in window.localStorage under ttc_gemini_api_key on chrome-untrusted://ai-overlay-dialog, and supports Retry / Change-API-key recovery from invalid keys. Auth precedence is CLI loadTimeData → saved WebUI key → bundle apiConfig.apiKey. (2b942fa) (d781f64)
    AIUI
  • Contextual Tasks / Glic wiring: voice queries now upload context when an audio stream is active or recently active (interaction timestamp and audio capture token are both consumed on submit to prevent double-reads), CommandAiModeUnshare is gated on the rearchitected side panel, Glic provider-switch notices drop from all hosts when the provider pref clears, GlicInactiveSidePanelUi::OnViewFocused posts activation with a weak pointer instead of destroying the observed view mid-dispatch, and Glic auto-submit moved into LaunchpadService. Side-panel WebContents now start initially_hidden so background rebuilds can't hijack the active task's ChipController. (1bb228f) (2b2da10) (296a5f8) (62d020a) (4103823)
    AIUITabs

Platform, Performance & Graphics

  • ClientSharedImage sync tokens are split into a single write_sync_token_ plus a per-sequence read_sync_token_map_: read-only accesses wait only on the write token and record their completion there instead of serializing behind prior reads. ExportedSharedImage mojom changes managed_sync_tokens → write_sync_token + read_sync_tokens (duplicate-client-ID validation retained per read token), and SharedImageTexture waits on creation_sync_token() directly. (0c43af3)
    GPUCompositorPerformance
  • WebNN: the WebNNContextProviderImpl worker moves to a dedicated base::Thread configured with gpu::CreateGpuSequenceManagerSettings() (required for gpu::Scheduler task queues that ThreadPool runners can't provide), and the kWebNNCompilerProcess default flips false → true on Windows with minimum WinAppRuntime 2.7.0. --webnn-ort-logging-level at INFO/VERBOSE now sets NPU.LOG_LEVEL=LOG_INFO inside the OpenVINO EP only. (565e7b7) (f6c3c2d) (a26856b) (66f5ef3)
    AIGPUWindows
  • WebAuthn GPM wiring: new GpmBrowserAuthenticatorDiscovery / GpmBrowserAuthenticatorController pull security-domain secrets from TrustedVaultClient, query TrustedVaultConnection for registration state, drive the AuthenticatorRequestDialogModel steps, and persist new passkeys to PasskeyModel. The follow-up moves EnclaveAuthenticatorDiscovery construction into ConfigureGpm(), deletes the consider_enclave flag and enclave EventStream plumbing, and attaches additional_discoveries unconditionally so embedder discoveries survive kInternal erasure on Windows. (9a48d09) (6fe241f)
    PasswordManagerSecurity
  • Windows USB: UsbDeviceHandleWin::Request now owns the transfer buffer for the operation's full lifetime and hands it back through StartWatchingCallback. Previously GenericTransfer passed and moved the buffer in the same MaybeStartWatching() call, and unspecified argument evaluation order could move it first — leaving Request::buffer_ unset while overlapped I/O was in flight. (baf0de3)
    USBWindows
  • Remoting hardening: HostEventDispatcher enforces kMaxEventMessageSizeBytes = 4096 (oversized event messages dropped without parsing, logged at most once per 10 s; messages with no InputStub dropped in release). WorkerProcessLauncher no longer schedules relaunch when auto_relaunch is false, duplicate associated-interface binds early-return after process crash handling, and the new Windows IoCompletionPortDrainer replaces a posted-task drain that could free Core while kernel job packets still referenced it. (22d0fcd) (2f8d1c8) (f53b183) (370d8a0)
    WindowsNetworkSecurity

Extensions, Data Models & Tooling

  • ExtensionSettings policy can now block on internal permissions via an allowlist mapping internal permissions to manifest keys (searchProvider, homepage, startupPages for chrome_settings_overrides, newTabPageOverride for chrome_url_overrides). A blocked permission prevents install and disables already-installed extensions. Backward compatible: other internal permissions remain ignored, manifests still cannot request internal permissions, and SettingsOverrideAPIPermission::FromValue now accepts valueless entries. (4ae4f73)
    ExtensionsPolicy
  • Extensions menu: a new kPrefPermissionsWithheldOnInstall / WerePermissionsWithheldOnInstall() pref is set at initial install when WITHHOLD_PERMISSIONS is present and persists across updates, ignoring post-install manual site-access changes. Views surface gains public site_permissions_button(), ExtensionsMenuMainPageView::GetMenuEntry() / ScrollToMenuEntry(), and kExtensionsMenuSiteAccessSectionElementId. (be149a5)
    ExtensionsUI
  • WebApp management state is consolidated into a single management_data_ field (proto tag 84) replacing sources_ and management_to_external_config_map_; the unused WebApp::AddExternalSourceInformation() is removed, WebAppRegistrar / ExternallyManagedAppManager / install jobs were updated, and a temporary v7 bridge translates between the old fields and ManagementData (a follow-up bumps WebAppDatabase to v8). On-disk format stays v7-compatible. (ef9d99c)
    BrowserStorage
  • New webui_mojo_library() GN rule compiles (and minifies when optimize_webui is on) a sibling mojom() target's .mojom-webui.ts bindings into target_gen_dir, resolves transitive Mojo library deps via mojo_target_deps, and emits a transitive manifest via generate_mojo_manifest() — useful for WebUI-heavy embedder builds. (518d980)
    BuildInfra

2026-11-20

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-20

Overview

On 2026-11-20 the main branch received **1,123 commits**, of which **837** were filtered as relevant to browser-layer, networking, extensions, security, performance and build work. The day's headline items are a cluster of **breaking embedder-facing API changes** (ContentBrowserClient::WillInterceptWebSocket(), ShowRepostFormWarningDialog(), BrowserWindow::GetExclusiveAccessContext(), the extensions feature-provider rework, OriginMatcher), several security fixes in workers/ServiceWorkers/WebRTC logging, measurable desktop startup performance work, and notable browser-behavior changes around --app=<url>, session persistence at shutdown, and tabCapture. Range: (08a1fa1) → (44c1bcd).

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient::WillInterceptWebSocket() changes from (RenderFrameHost*) to (RenderFrameHost*, BrowserContext*); the context is derived from the initiator's RenderProcessHost and is documented as never null, so embedders can enforce per-context policy for service-worker and shared-worker connections where frame is null. The in-tree change is behavior-neutral, but every out-of-tree override must be updated and recompiled. (9f0499b)
    NetworkBrowser
  • ⚠️WebContentsDelegate::ShowRepostFormWarningDialog() and NavigationControllerDelegate::ActivateAndShowRepostFormWarningDialog() now return bool instead of void. Returning false (the default, "embedder cannot show the dialog") cancels the pending reload, so Headless Chrome and content_shell get an error instead of hanging — update all overrides. Paired with an opt-in, default-off checkForRepost parameter on DevTools Page.reload. (0df9dbc)
    NavigationBrowser
  • ⚠️The pure-virtual BrowserWindow::GetExclusiveAccessContext() is removed from chrome/browser/ui/browser_window.h. Migrate to ExclusiveAccessManager::From(browser)->context() or the extracted BrowserViewExclusiveAccessContext::From(browser); context ownership moves to BrowserWindowFeatures and the type splits into its own GN target (//chrome/browser/ui/exclusive_access:browser_view_exclusive_access_context). ~41 in-tree files updated, all downstream consumers break. (25174f9)
    UIBrowser
  • ⚠️Extensions feature registration rework with no deprecation window: ExtensionsAPIProvider's pure-virtual Add*Features(FeatureProvider*) methods become const Get*Features() returning extensions::StaticFeatureTable; FeatureProvider::GetAllFeatures() returns a FeatureSpan (std::vector<const Feature*>) instead of the name-keyed FeatureMap; FeatureProvider is now final with a non-virtual destructor; the json_features GN method_name convention flips Add* → Get*. Motive was allocation/perf only (Win x64 Release: 18 → 4 startup allocations, ~12.4 KB → 4.1 KB retained, ~42 → ~14 µs warm construction). (7481681)
    ExtensionsBuild
  • ⚠️OriginMatcher storage and accessor contract changes: rules() returns base::span<const std::unique_ptr<OriginMatcherRule>> over a sorted, deduplicated base::flat_set; OriginMatcherRule gains operator<=> and OriginMatcherRuleType is renumbered (kAny = 0, kSubdomain = 1). This is a semantic change too — Serialize() output is now sorted and deduplicated, so audit persisted or round-tripped rule lists, not just call sites. (9d3a473)
    SecurityNetwork
  • ⚠️Two narrower public-surface removals: content::WebContents's pure-virtual RequestAXTreeSnapshotWithinBrowserProcess() / ApplyAXTreeFixingResult() and features::kAXTreeFixing are deleted (the feature never launched, limiting blast radius), and OnDeviceTranslationServiceLauncher::Launch() gains a required language_packs argument plus a new pure-virtual UpdateLanguagePacks(). Delete the overrides / update subclasses. (6d81723) (5d57184)
    AccessibilityAI

Build & Toolchain

  • ⚠️Apple platforms stop building //buildtools/third_party/libc++abi: an assert(!is_apple, ...) is added to that target and //buildtools/third_party/libc++ now links the system c++abi via a public_config. _LIBCXXABI_DISABLE_VISIBILITY_ANNOTATIONS is no longer defined on Apple, __config_site forces _LIBCPP_AVAILABILITY_HAS_INIT_PRIMARY_EXCEPTION 0 for deployment targets below macOS 15 / iOS·tvOS 18 / watchOS 11, and chrome/BUILD.gn allowlists /usr/lib/libc++abi.dylib. Any embedder GN reference to the in-tree libc++abi target fails at generation time. (3758a35)
    BuildmacOS
  • ⚠️GN gating changes that break downstream integrations: policy::switches::kUseFakeDmserver is now declared only under the new allow_fake_dmserver buildflag (is_linux && !is_chrome_branded), so non-branded Windows/macOS builds referencing it fail to compile or silently lose fake-DMS enrollment (use policy::IsFakeDmserverEnabled() instead). Separately, GN actions now invoke Python with -ES, so out-of-tree actions relying on PYTHONPATH or site-packages stop working; print_python_deps.py picks vpython3 vs cpython3 -BES from the script shebang. (dd911f3) (e04af43)
    BuildPolicy

Security & Networking

  • Dedicated workers whose script response carries a CSP sandbox directive without allow-same-origin now get an opaque StorageKey with cross-site ancestor-chain semantics, and inherited Storage Access API status is cleared on both browser and renderer paths — closing a first-party cookie/authority leak through WebSocket handshakes, subresource fetches and worker-bound Mojo. Adds content::DeriveOpaqueStorageKey(); OnScriptLoadStarted() and blink::WebDedicatedWorker gain an updated_origin parameter. Kill switch CSPSandboxedWorkerOpaqueOrigin (default on). (adc26fc)
    SecurityStorage
  • ServiceWorker race-network-and-fetch-handler no longer re-dispatches post-fallback redirects as a fresh FetchEvent, which previously exposed post-redirect cross-origin URLs and credentialed redirect parameters to the worker via event.request.url. Also fixes a CorsURLLoader state-machine bypass that dropped opaque response tainting on cross-origin→same-origin redirects in no-cors mode, implemented by reclaiming the in-flight URLLoader with TakeURLLoader() and forwarding FollowRedirect() on the existing pipe. (8f1eee4)
    ServiceWorkerNetworkSecurity
  • WebRTC text logging hardened against symlink attacks: no symlink following for the log list, .gz/.meta files or the log directory itself; atomic writes via base::ImportantFileWriter (POSIX mkstemp/0600); a 1 MB cap on the log index; unusable log directories degrade gracefully instead of tripping the OnLoggingStopped() CHECK; RTP dump cleanup refuses symlinked parents. Remaining limit: the checks are path-based and can still be raced. (627ba39)
    WebRTCSecurity
  • WebSocket close-handshake semantics restored: transport END_STREAM/shutdown is sent only after the closing handshake completes rather than on any client Close frame, fixing spurious 1006 closures against servers that don't implement half-close while staying RFC-compliant. A bool shutdown is threaded through WebSocketStream::WriteFrames() and the TCP/SPDY/QUIC adapters, zero-length final (FIN-only) writes become legal, and HTTP/3 handshake re-entrancy is fixed via base::AutoReset scoping and WeakPtr binding. (6011ccf) (bfc1d8f)
    Network
  • Networking API and hardening: NetworkContextParams gains an additive default_url_loader_network_observer, consulted after the per-factory observer and before the global NetworkService default — note the documented caveat that it also applies to internal factories the context creates (CertNetFetcher, prefetch), so never attach an auto-approving observer to a context serving less-trusted factories. Also, failed HTTPS variations-seed fetches no longer retry over HTTP unless the seed itself delivers kVariationsHttpFallback, so clients behind restrictive proxies may hold a stale or first-run seed. (25feb43) (27d74d4)
    NetworkSecurity
  • Accept-Language truncation to 10 languages is now unconditional: kReduceAcceptLanguageCount and the kMaxAcceptLanguage FeatureParam are deleted in favor of inline constexpr size_t kMaxAcceptLanguageCount = 10 in language_prefs.h, enforced in GetLanguagesWithMaxCount(). Field-trial configs and embedder code referencing the removed symbols stop compiling, and the header / navigator.languages are now always capped. (5f4b5a6)
    NetworkI18n

Browser Behavior & UI

  • --app=<url> now resolves against installed web apps on desktop: a URL in the scope of an installed, OS-integrated web app launches that app's window instead of a URL-derived app window, so window identity changes from chrome-<host>__<path>-Default to the app's (taskbar/dock grouping and OS integration now apply). Startup becomes asynchronous when the web-app registry isn't loaded yet (mirroring --app-id), with a synchronous plain-window fallback when nothing matches — review deployment scripts relying on per-URL window identity. (255d9e9)
    Browser
  • Window placement and session commands now persist at logout/shutdown: chrome::SessionEnding() previously terminated the process without closing windows, and SessionService commands waited on a 2.5 s timer that never fired. Placement is now saved least→most recently active (most-recent window wins the "new window" pref) and BrowserProcessImpl::EndSession() flushes pending SessionService/AppSessionService commands with SaveNow(), so recent moves and session edits survive WM_ENDSESSION and SIGTERM. (cd07d89) (5508e38)
    BrowserTabs
  • macOS app shim lifecycle: notification dispatcher entries are now evicted on profile close / PWA uninstall instead of being retained indefinitely, and the up-to-9 automatic backoff retries are replaced by a four-state DisplayedNotificationsState so connections only claim notifications after actually responding — eliminating spurious background shim launches (No profile for background launch) and speculative relaunches of broken shims. Separately, the "wait for launch files/URLs" AppShimController change is reverted (crbug.com/585883649), restoring a known Finder/Dock file- and URL-handler launch race; re-test those paths. (954d010) (fe8acf0) (51ada56)
    macOSNotifications
  • Views/UI behavior changes: ui::views::MenuController::Run() now auto-selects the first item for keyboard-opened menus even when parent is nullptr, affecting all parentless context menus on Windows and macOS — verify embedder menu expectations. Global Media Controls now refresh items in place: stopping a TAB_MIRROR route no longer dismisses the dialog (matching Remote Playback) and stale "Stop Casting" buttons are refreshed, via a shared MediaSessionRouteObserver. Windows status tray opts into NOTIFYICON_VERSION_4 with keyboard/Narrator activation. (5382faf) (09ddfe6)
    UIMedia
  • ⚠️chrome.tabCapture.getMediaStreamId() IDs and pending tabCapture.capture() calls no longer survive a target-tab navigation that commits before getUserMedia() is processed — including same-origin navigations, reloads, the first navigation of a newly created tab, and BFCache restores; redemption now fails with AbortError. Extensions calling capture() immediately after tabs.create() must wait for load. TabCaptureRegistry::VerifyRequest() drops its extension_id parameter and gains KillUnverifiedRequest() / a PrimaryPageChanged() hook. (534eed1)
    ExtensionsMedia

Performance

  • macOS launch-phase task draining (reland, MacPumpTasksBeforeFinishLaunching): MessagePumpNSApplication drains ready immediate UI tasks up to ~18 ms before -[NSApplication run] and ~45 ms after finishLaunching, skipping idle work and aborting on Quit(), so GPU/frame-sink/WebUI/navigation work runs before _DPSNextEvent blocks. Measured on mac-m1-pro-perf: BrowserWindow.FirstPaint −14.7% (289.7→247.0 ms), NewTabPage.MainUi.ShownTime −19.7%, initial WebUI ReloadButton FCP −14.4%. (3a435e1)
    PerformancemacOS
  • Startup cost reductions behind the new InitialWebUIChromeOptimizations umbrella: PageActionContainerView creates children lazily on first visibility with lightweight ordering placeholders (FirstPaint 243.2→228.8 ms, ReloadButton FCP 319.5→292.8 ms, NonEmptyPaint3 384.8→376.5 ms), and ThemeSource gains an 8-entry LRU cache keyed by ColorProvider::unique_id() plus parsed ColorsCssParams for colors.css (208 µs → 5 µs on repeated requests, ~0.7 MB retained, behind ColorIdCssStyleSheetCache). (fa54ad7) (99a176f)
    PerformanceUI
  • NtpRendererKeepAlive (disabled by default) pins the last committed first-party WebUI NTP renderer per profile — skipping when policy, an extension or a third-party DSE overrides the NTP, or process caps are hit, and releasing on moderate+ memory pressure: measured Ctrl+T MainUI −59.5 ms (−23.3%). Also on macOS, Mojo batches Mach voucher release per channel via a new MachVoucherReleasePool on a worker thread instead of destroying ports inline under the heavily contended global port-table lock on the IO thread. (9477fcb) (42c3fca)
    PerformancemacOS

Extensions, DevTools & Enterprise

  • DevTools security tightening: InspectorDOMAgent::NodeForBackendId() now validates that a node's execution context resolves to a frame in inspected_frames_, so renderer-process-global backend node IDs can no longer reach nodes of other same-process targets (e.g. same-site popups) via describeNode, resolveNode, getBoxModel, highlightNode, getPartialAXTree or queryAXTree — cross-target lookups fail with "No node found for given backend id". BiDi restricted sessions now filter events against default/perNavigable ACL grants at send time (closing a cross-tab leak of URLs, console messages and dialog text), with event buffering disabled entirely under ACL enforcement so pre-grant events are not replayed. (86664f3) (be00bc5)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • Enterprise and policy: PromotionsEnabled=false now suppresses the PDF default-handler and pin-to-taskbar infobars (relevant to managed Windows/macOS fleets and embedders shipping these); kDisableScreenshots is consolidated into components/policy/core/common/policy_pref_names.h with the same persisted pref key, so it is a compile-level constant relocation for all callers; DevTools ExtensionsHandler::CanAccessStorage() now requires IsInspectionAllowed() before exposing extension storage (kDevToolsExtensionStorageInspectionCheck, on by default). (12ec3ae) (7ce66cd) (33cfe73) (ad78c21)
    EnterprisePolicyExtensions
  • Sync and preference integrity: SyncEngine/SyncEncryptionHandler gain SetTrustedVaultEncryptionPassphrase() for client-initiated enrollment into on-device encryption (additive, but out-of-tree implementations must add it); Nigori timestamps are no longer silently coerced to the Unix epoch when unset; and tracked-preference validation distinguishes UNDECRYPTABLE_ENCRYPTED/UNAVAILABLE_ENCRYPTED from INVALID_ENCRYPTED so OS key rotation no longer wipes extensions, default search engine, pinned tabs, account prefs or session.restore_on_startup (kTreatUndecryptableEncryptedHashAsMissing, on by default — ValidationResult grew, so update exhaustive switches). (0da9a27) (89993e9) (d893ff2)
    SyncBase

2026-11-19

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-19

Overview

On 2026-11-19 the main branch received 1240 commits, of which roughly 960 were judged relevant to Chromium embedders. The range runs from (1459778) to (88225bf). Five confirmed breaking changes land in embedder-facing interfaces (extension response payloads, NavigationUIData, TabStripModelObserver, ComponentUpdateService::Cancel, and the system proxy resolver switch), alongside several security hardening fixes, Windows/macOS browser UI work, measurable performance wins in bookmark menus and text layout, and build-level changes around C23 and PartitionAlloc.

Breaking Changes & Required Migrations

  • ⚠️Breaking: extensions::ExtensionFunction::ResponseCallback now carries extensions::mojom::ResponseWrapperPtr instead of base::ListValue, and the same substitution ripples through LocalFrameHost.Request() and ServiceWorkerHost.RequestWorker() via a new ResponseWrapper union. Embedders that subclass ExtensionFunction, install a custom response_callback_, or implement those mojom methods must migrate. This is CL 1/3 moving declarativeNetRequest.getDynamicRules() serialization off the browser UI thread (up to 30,000 rules per call). (af69b74)
    ExtensionsPerformance
  • ⚠️Breaking: content::NavigationUIData::CloneForNewNavigation() is renamed to MaybeCreateForRedispatchedNavigation() with a clarified contract (subclasses may return nullptr when all caller-supplied fields are default). Any embedder overriding the virtual or calling the redispatch clone in OpenURLParams::FromNavigationHandle() fails to compile until migrated. (797a1d8)
    NavigationBrowser
  • ⚠️Breaking: TabStripModelObserver::OnTabBlockedStateChanged(tabs::TabInterface*) becomes OnTabBlockedStateChanged(tabs::TabHandle), and the newer OnTabChanged(tabs::TabHandle, TabChangeType) hook is added (defaulting to forward to the deprecated OnTabChangedAt, with in-tree observers migrated). Downstream browser forks implementing either observer member must update. (749b032) (ad58ca3) (c2fa9e1) (7f05439)
    TabsUI
  • ⚠️Breaking: ComponentUpdateService::Cancel(id) becomes Cancel(id, update_client::CancelMode), a new pure virtual on the exported, commonly-mocked updater interface. All embedder implementations and mocks break. Runtime behavior is deliberately unchanged for now (UrlFetcherDownloader::Cancel ignores kKeepPartialDownload), and CrxUpdateService::CancelMeteredDownloads() now picks the mode per component. (03e4b71)
    UpdaterExtensions
  • ⚠️Breaking: switches::kUseSystemProxyResolver is deleted. Native system proxy resolution (WinHTTP on Windows, CFNetwork on macOS) is now gated by BASE_FEATURE(kSystemProxyResolver, FEATURE_DISABLED_BY_DEFAULT) enabled via --enable-features=SystemProxyResolver, with legacy --winhttp-proxy-resolver taking precedence. Proxy-service construction — including the URLRequestContextBuilderMojo path — always routes through net::ConfiguredProxyResolutionService::CreateUsingSystemProxyResolver(), so out-of-tree system-resolver implementations are affected, and macOS PAC execution is still unsupported in the utility-process resolver. (8a813b9)
    NetworkmacOSWindows

Security & Privacy

  • getDisplayMedia frame-rate constraints can no longer crash the browser process: an ideal frameRate of 0, negative or subnormal produced a 0 fps value that passed VideoCaptureFormat::IsValid() and hit a DCHECK_GT/divide-by-zero in DesktopCaptureDevice. Constraint selection now enforces a 1/1024 fps minimum, non-positive rates are rejected before reaching the device, and the device-level check is a CHECK_GT. (580ea91)
    MediaSecurity
  • GWP-ASan and on-demand heap profiling are restored in release/official builds. An over-broad EXPENSIVE_TEST_LOGIC_IS_ON() guard had disabled GWP-ASan in production and flipped PoissonAllocationSamplerInclusion to kDynamic, breaking Perfetto HeapProfilingDataSource and DevTools Memory.startSampling; kEnforce is now unconditional with hooks deferred until sampling starts. (0bece1a)
    BaseSecurityDevTools
  • IDN spoof-check hardening: the whole-script-confusable loop in IDNSpoofChecker::SafeToDisplayAsUnicode() now runs for all USPOOF_SINGLE_SCRIPT_RESTRICTIVE labels before the kana/combining-mark exception gate, closing a bypass where one added combining mark (U+0301/U+0326) suppressed the check on Cyrillic/Greek lookalikes. Relatedly, dragged .url shortcuts now sanitize Windows reserved device names (COM1.url → _COM1.url) and base::IsReservedNameOnWindows() also matches superscript device digits and trailing-space variants. (ba5d1b8) (952223d)
    NetworkSecurityWindows
  • Origin validation tightened in two user-visible surfaces: persistent notification click/close events are only dispatched to a service-worker registration that is live and whose storage key matches the notification's origin (including notifications already persisted with attacker-supplied registration IDs), and PiP/always-on-top title bars resolve non-standard and filesystem: URLs from the committed or precursor origin tuple with ELIDE_HEAD restricted to hierarchical HTTP(S), blocking origin spoofing in the window title. (0e75955) (cb1367d)
    NotificationsSecurityUI

Networking & Authentication

  • All Windows SSPI work (AcquireCredentialsHandle, InitializeSecurityContext) is serialized on a single shared sequence, still off the network thread. Overlapping calls against the same typed credentials previously failed with SEC_E_INVALID_TOKEN, breaking NTLM/Negotiate authentication. Gated by kSerializeSspiCalls in net/base/features, restoring branch-156 serialization semantics. (c4a99be)
    NetworkWindows
  • HostResolverManager no longer aborts in-flight DNS transactions when configuration arrives or refreshes, except for transactions that genuinely depended on the configuration. On Windows and macOS, where the platform resolver owns nameserver and Private DNS selection, this removes spurious early/concurrent lookup failures during network transitions. (b45ed08)
    Network
  • Device Bound Session Credentials now reject cross-site refresh session configs by default (kDeviceBoundSessionsRequireSameSiteRefresh, shipped enabled): a refresh response whose final registration URL is not same-site with the fetcher endpoint fails fatally (SessionError::kCrossSiteRefreshSessionConfig) and the existing session is deleted. Separately, CacheStorageCache truncates stale stream bytes, so an opaque response body can no longer remain readable after an empty put (both the response header and blob paths were fixed). (d296a63) (47f720b)
    NetworkSecurityStorage

Browser UI & Lifecycle (Windows/macOS)

  • macOS status tray rework: StatusIconMac keeps NSMenu populated across all modes, swizzles -[NSStatusBarButton mouseDown:] alongside rightMouseDown: so plain left-clicks dispatch click events when open_menu_with_secondary_click() is set (Control-click, right-click and VoiceOver AXPress open the menu), defers mid-tracking menu rebuilds to NSMenuDidEndTrackingNotification, and keeps accessibilityLabel in sync with the tooltip. Custom StatusIconMac consumers should be re-tested. (0786bf2)
    macOSUIAccessibility
  • App menu behavior: browser shortcuts no longer leave the App menu open (BrowserNativeWidgetMac::ExecuteCommand cancels the owning Views menu after WillExecuteCommand confirms the command runs, leaving textfield editing shortcuts untouched), and app-menu search now scores multi-word queries word-by-word across title, secondary text and synonyms with cross-field discounts, adds zoom/fullscreen/light-dark-mode synonyms, and fixes zoom tooltip casing. (3ba6779) (60cb8bb) (b926ccd) (f19aa5b)
    UImacOSBrowser
  • Startup/shutdown lifetime fixes: the profile picker is shown before its profile's windows close so its process keep-alive is registered (previously cancelling device-signals consent could shut the app down with the picker open); RenderWidgetHostViewAura retains its LocalSurfaceId across the first navigation while no content has been shown (fixes an empty first paint such as the startup WebUI toolbar); and spare renderer creation is once again scaled by memory pressure when kKillSpareRenderOnMemoryPressure is off. (edf9bd8) (77cd885) (c5f520d)
    BrowserProfilesCompositor
  • Windows-specific fixes: BrowserWindowPropertyManager::UpdateWindowProperties() and ProfileShortcutManagerWin::OnProfileIconCreateSuccess() now skip work when a profile has no ProfileAttributesEntry (previously a NotFatalUntil::M162 CHECK followed by a null dereference in multi-profile builds), and the recovery image writer issues IOCTL_DISK_DELETE_DRIVE_LAYOUT/IOCTL_DISK_UPDATE_PROPERTIES before raw writes so Windows can no longer remount stale partitions over a verified image. (992ab8a) (bc63579)
    WindowsProfilesUI

Extensions, Enterprise & Policy

  • Extension accelerator registration for off-the-record windows is now gated on IsExtensionAllowedInContext(), with defense-in-depth in ExecuteCommands(), CommandExecuted(), DispatchCommandEvent() and ActiveTabPermissionGranter::GrantIfRequested(). This fixes both a focus-steal with incognito-split extension windows and a cross-incognito activeTab grant / commands.onCommand leak; OnExtensionUnloaded() stays unguarded so revoking incognito access still unregisters accelerators. (d637beb)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • InstallPromptData gains GetNonHostPermissions()/GetNonHostPermissionCount(), site-access header/option/subtext getters, and visible plus collapsed bulleted site lists, with new extensions_strings.grd entries. GetPermissions() is intentionally unchanged, so the install dialog is unaffected until the follow-up Views/Android CLs. (99647db)
    ExtensionsUI
  • Enterprise policy changes: OIDC policy and client registration are preserved across profile switches (only reset when the store lacks valid policy or the connected client uses a different DM token), the Azure AD workplace-join escape hatch kFilterSensitivePoliciesOnWorkplaceJoinedDevices is removed (default behavior unchanged, but the runtime rollback lever is gone), and Indigo gains disabled-by-default client-side country/locale eligibility filtering that records the would-be result once per session. (0412f45) (856b651) (eb21c12)
    EnterprisePolicyProfiles

Performance

  • macOS bookmark menus defer title elision and favicon loading to an interactive NSMenu tracking session under kBookmarkMenuOptimizations: AppKit traversal of 210K bookmarks drops from ~23 s to under 1 s, profile teardown from ~19 s to ~1 s, and opening a 100-item folder costs ~25–40 ms. (Help-menu search still finalizes eagerly.) (25ba7ca)
    BookmarksmacOSPerformance
  • Latency and allocation wins: Safe Browsing page-activation callbacks now run on the BrowserTaskType::kNavigationNetworkResponse UI runner (feature-flagged) instead of congested default-priority tasks, and DevTools Fetch request interception replaces base::flat_set<ResourceType> with a 4-byte base::EnumSet bitmask, removing per-pattern heap allocation and shrinking Pattern::Matches() to an inline test. (8476cd8) (44f204d)
    NetworkDevToolsPerformance
  • OnDeviceTailModelService now stores delivered model files but defers TFLite interpreter construction (reusing the existing memory-pressure unload/load-on-demand path) until the first RunTailModelExecutor() request, so clients no longer keep the interpreter resident when the model is never used. (e3163ac)
    PerformanceAI

Build, Base & I18n

  • C and Objective-C compilation moves to C23 (/std:clatest on clang-cl, -std=c23 elsewhere); .m files inherit it. Downstream .c/.m code that uses unreachable/deprecated as identifiers or type-positioned attributes may need fixes — the reland had to pin weston to C11 for exactly that reason. (7332e81)
    Build
  • USING_FAST_MALLOC is now a no-op under USE_PARTITION_ALLOC_AS_MALLOC (no class-level operator new/delete; sized and over-aligned allocation preserved), and raw_ptr enforcement widens: the plugin now enforces raw_ptr inside std::vector and the VectorExperimental/SetExperimental/CtnExperimental container traits are dropped from chrome/browser/ui containers, enabling PartitionAlloc dangling-pointer detection — expect new diagnostics or dangling-pointer crashes in debug/ASan configurations. (75365f0) (018e5be) (7de023f)
    BaseBuildSecurity
  • I18n and resource plumbing: IcuBridge::ListFormatter adds a thread-safe, locale-bound formatter with FormatStandardList(), FormatNarrowList() and FormatUnitList() behind an 8-entry LRU cache; base::i18n::LanguageTag::IsUndefined() is added to detect "und" tags from PrefService::GetLanguageTag(); and Windows string-resource generation now fails closed with a RuntimeError when a requested string ID or active-brand mode-specific string is missing from the .grd inputs. (13ff688) (5986229) (4e3a53b)
    I18nBaseBuild

2026-11-18

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-18

Overview
