1,271 commits landed on main on 2026-11-18, of which roughly 1,016 are relevant to embedders building Chromium-based projects on Windows and macOS (Blink rendering internals, ChromeOS/Ash, Linux, iOS and Android-only work excluded). The day is defined by a cluster of **breaking API removals** across resource packaging, Blink embedder interfaces, content/public, views and the file system access factory, alongside substantial networking/security hardening (Negotiate target-host validation, GPU context-confusion fixes) and a large macOS bookmark-menu performance win. Range: (f3b7097) → (6af779c).

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️Resource packaging defaults to zstd: GRIT now compresses .js/.html/.css/.svg/.json and .code_cache with zstd, ui::ResourceBundle::IsGzipped()/IsBrotli() are deleted in favour of IsCompressed(), and the extensions source-map path loads through LoadDataResourceString(). Custom .pak pipelines and embedders calling the removed ui/base APIs must migrate; the related Brotli code-cache pass shrinks bundled resources by ~15.6%. (4a89327) (3f2c376)
    BaseBuild
  • ⚠️Blink embedder interface removals: WebView::PageEncoding(), WebLocalFrameClient::SetUpSharedMemoryForDroppedFrames(), RenderFrameObserver::DetailedConsoleMessageAdded() and WebLocalFrameClient::DidAddMessageToConsole() are gone (console reporting now flows through WebLocalFrameObserver/blink::Platform), and FrameHost::UpdateEncoding moved to blink.mojom.LocalMainFrameHost, so encoding updates originate in Blink. Out-of-tree embedders and custom IPC mocks no longer compile. (e1489bc) (5781c29) (716ea16)
    BlinkBrowser
  • ⚠️content/public and scheme-registry lock: BrowserThread::PostBestEffortTask() is removed outright (use ThreadPool::PostTask with TaskPriority::BEST_EFFORT plus BindPostTask), and the new WebSecurityPolicy::LockSchemeRegistries() hard-locks custom scheme registration after RenderThreadStarted() — a DCHECK in debug but a silent no-op in release, so late RegisterURLScheme* calls just stop working. (94a7b45) (4e6d72e)
    BaseSecurityBlink
  • ⚠️url::SchemeHostPort/url::Origin reject empty hosts: non-file: standard schemes with an empty host are now invalid, GetURL() enforces the invariant, and Mojo Origin deserialization fails for tuples such as ("chrome", "", 0). Embedders registering custom standard schemes or inflating such origins receive invalid values or a CHECK crash instead of a round-trippable origin. (73392c2)
    NetworkSecurity
  • ⚠️File System Access entry-factory signature change: FileSystemAccessEntryFactory::CreateFileEntryFromPath() gains a required SensitiveEntryReadCheck, and SharedHandleState gains an optional read_blocklist_exempt_path. This restores Windows PWA file_handlers launches and drag-and-drop of files staged in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp; deserialized handles are now also checked against the sensitive-entry blocklist. (ea88bf4) (975ab82)
    StorageSecurityWindows
  • ⚠️Branded search-provider overrides removed: switches::kIgnoreSearchProviderOverrides, TemplateURLPrepopulateData::GetOverriddenTemplateURLData(), ClearPrepopulatedEnginesInPrefs() and BrandcodedDefaultSettings::GetSearchProviderOverrides() are deleted, and DefaultSearchManager no longer observes prefs::kSearchProviderOverrides. Builds shipping a default engine via search_provider_overrides silently stop applying it and must move to kDefaultSearchProviderData or policy. (587dacd)
    BrowserProfiles
  • ⚠️views::FocusManager::ViewRemoved() takes the new parent: the signature becomes ViewRemoved(View*, View* new_parent) with no default argument, alongside the new views::kRetainsFocusWhenReparented property; removing a subtree now notifies the focus manager once per subtree rather than once per descendant. Callers such as NativeViewHost::ClearFocus() must pass the parameter, and focus-observer timing changes for reparented views. (18cfccd)
    UIBrowser

Security & Networking

  • Negotiate/GSSAPI target-host validation: the DNS canonical name substituted for the SPN is now re-checked against HttpAuthPreferences allowlists before and after the handshake (kValidateNegotiateCnameAllowlist, kValidateNegotiateTargetPrincipalHost), so ambient credentials or delegation tickets cannot go to an unrequested host, including via PTR lookups. AuthServerAllowlist, AuthNegotiateDelegateAllowlist and DisableAuthNegotiateCnameLookup now document canonical-host requirements — CNAME-based SPNs with non-canonical allowlist entries may start failing. (461e753) (16cfb97)
    NetworkEnterpriseSecurity
  • GPU context-confusion and device-loss hardening: OzoneImageBacking now uses ScopedMakeCurrent before UploadFromMemory/ReadbackToMemory (previously Skia could import a NativePixmap onto the wrong GLContext during overlay fallback copies), D3D shared images promote cleared state after EndAccess(), failed writePixels flushes its discard-clear, Dawn representations tolerate device loss, and a lost Dawn context restarts the GPU process rather than leaving commands running against stale memory. (f1831b8) (51ef3bb) (0fb2fd2) (d03ec5f)
    GPUSecuritymacOS
  • Renderer trust-boundary fixes: worker StorageKey origins are verified against the script URL (blocking cross-origin ServiceWorker registration promotion via WithOrigin()), SharedWorkerConnectorImpl is document-scoped so teardown can't resolve against a new document, renderer-supplied popup bounds are clamped to 16384 DIP, and WebNN's ORT embed_mode must be explicitly 1 to prevent GPU-process file reads. (d031101) (bba4565) (811be3d) (de3207d)
    SecurityNetworkGPU
  • Use-after-free and lifetime fixes on browser paths: the extensions toolbar re-validates WebContents/toolbar-view lifetime after synchronous accessibility events fire, the suspicious-site warning bubble records state before showing (listeners can destroy the controller), content-setting bubble models clear observations via the new UrlListManager::Observer::OnUrlListManagerDestroying(), and extension BlobReader completes on error status instead of hanging on empty blobs. (cbdc76e) (68ab81d) (b3e0c16) (b4de932)
    ExtensionsSecurityUI
  • Network and cache integrity: SimpleCache index mutations are guarded so doomed entries cannot delete a replacement's hash, NetErrorAutoReloader no longer re-triggers downloads when a tab regains visibility, offline pages strip X-Chrome-offline across redirects and refuse cross-site redirects for background auto-fetch, and IDN skeleton mapping adds U+0269/U+045F confusables to close homograph spoofing gaps. (6de3636) (4f0b3f6) (90faeca) (aa00b7f)
    NetworkStorageSecurity

Browser UI (Windows / macOS)

  • WebUI omnibox fixes gating the toolbar rollout: focus-select-all now bumps the UI state version so the next keystroke replaces instead of appending to the URL, selection is saved on blur and restored on window reactivation, selected host text can be dragged as a URL like Views, and the popup blurs while a tab drag is in flight via BrowserWidget::RegisterTabDraggingStatusChanged(). (11e7a1e) (ec72da7) (1f01209) (54682f8)
    UIBrowser
  • Desktop UI correctness fixes: IME composition is preserved in ChroMenu search (row rebuilds no longer steal focus from a focused Textfield), the infobar queue badge becomes an accessible "X of Y" indicator, ModalDialogHost implementations now return widget-coordinate dialog positions, and the bottom-anchored address bar no longer leaves the progress-bar layer stuck at the screen bottom. (f2ef307) (807bc75) (aae8011) (191bf71)
    UIWindowsmacOS
  • Settings and NTP modernization: settings pages continue the Lit migration (all_sites, cr-infinite-list) with dark-theme contrast restored to WCAG AA, legacy chrome://settings subpages route through the 2026 refresh redirects under kWebuiRefresh2026, ~20 NTP templates move to runtime I18nMixinLit lookups so served bytes no longer vary per locale (unblocking bundled code caching), and Secure DNS provider visibility moves into a shared SecureDnsHandler check. (0e53996) (3ba377a) (97f7c55) (0923788)
    UIThemesI18n

Performance

  • macOS bookmark menu performance: behind kBookmarkMenuOptimizations, titles are elided once per item, the default favicon NSImage is reused, favicon callbacks update only the icon, and teardown stops starting new favicon loads. On an Apple Silicon VM with 210K bookmarks: menu open 61.7s → 24.2s (favicon drain 20.2s → 1.6s) and profile teardown 41.8s → 20.1s. (aaa43d2) (ac50863)
    macOSPerformanceBookmarks
  • Pref-load and autofill hot paths: PrefHashFilter::FinalizeFilterOnLoad() no longer deep-copies the whole PrefService store twice on the UI thread (250KB Preferences: 1.9ms → 0.7ms with extensions, 0.39ms → 0.02ms without), and AutofillProfileComparator switches from std::set to base::flat_set to drop per-token allocations. (afffda7) (67e05d0)
    PerformanceAutofillPrivacy
  • Mac startup optimization reverted (net regression): the task-drain before -[NSApplication run]/finishLaunching that measured −53ms Startup.BrowserWindow.FirstPaint and −52ms InitialWebUI...FirstContentfulPaint was backed out by LUCI bisection for CloudManagement enrollment test failures; message_pump_apple returns to the previous behavior and a reland is expected — embedders should not rely on the improvement at this revision. (6d64b86) (00ce8e7)
    macOSPerformanceBase

Extensions & DevTools

  • Extensions API surface updates: webRequest.onCompleted can expose securityInfo (TLS version, IANA cipher suite) behind kWebRequestSecurityInfo, windows.* events now fire for standalone WindowControllers such as Document PiP, tabs.discard() returns a PiP-specific error instead of misbehaving, and a new additive ExtensionsBrowserClient::OnWillExecuteScript() hook lets embedders attribute script injections for content analysis. The extensions menu site-access path no longer CHECK-crashes on stale permission state. (b87eb6c) (a6d3d9e) (8928d4c) (7efc24c)
    ExtensionsEnterprise
  • Enterprise extension telemetry for Isolated Mode: signals from Isolated Mode profiles are no longer dropped — a per-profile ExtensionTelemetryService reports exclusively to the enterprise pipeline with a 30s interval, Action gains a non-persisted isolated_mode flag independent of incognito bits, and stale temporary client-cert identities are now deleted instead of blocking provisioning until policy is disabled. (f07e436) (b27030d) (54321b6)
    ExtensionsEnterprisePolicy
  • DevTools / CDP changes: tab targets gain an "unloaded" subtype (discarded, restored-without-load or crashed tabs) reported through Target.getTargets with de-duplicated target-info events, frame-tree tracing skips BFCache and pending-deletion frames and emits isOpaqueOrigin, forwarded session messages using browser-only Target.* methods are rejected, and WebDriver BiDi adds goog:browsingContext.getAccessibilityTree plus ACL-restricted sessions (goog:acl). (c39cd20) (6086d01) (1f6d884) (fb29af0)
    DevToolsAccessibility

Build, Toolchain & Platform

  • Node.js major bump in the toolchain: DEPS moves the bundled Node from v24.12.0 to v26.13.1 LTS, bundled with rust llvm-wrapper, Error Prone and a dump_syms zstd fix that removes a release-mode segfault on compressed .debug_info. Build scripts, WebUI build steps or tooling invoking the bundled Node may break on the two-major delta. (b13ee12)
    BuildInfra
  • GN/build-config removals downstream builds must track: the enable_webui_tabstrip_ntb arg is gone (guards now use is_android), //components/cbor:buildflags and cbor_buildflags.h are deleted, bin/javac-graalvm is replaced by the multi-tool bin/jdk-tools-graalvm (keep the jdk-chromium autoroller paused), -Wglobal-constructors now covers all of //chrome/browser:core, and SuperSize only writes zstd .size v2 files. (e2c1d0b) (e317e9b) (e84c0db) (c5c3452) (4b32f88)
    BuildInfra
  • New developer tooling: mb check <path> <target> runs gn check --with-transitive-deps against compiled ninja targets, generate_mojo_manifest() emits JS/TS declaration metadata for WebUI Mojo targets, Swift steps can depend on build outputs via apple_tool_wrapper_swift_inputs, the Mojo bindings checker now rejects [Unverified] on handles/remotes/receivers, and generate_compdb.py --build-headers makes clangd resolve generated headers without a full build. (5d73f20) (b9926f2) (225588d) (989edbb)
    BuildInfraTesting
  • Windows/macOS platform changes: os_crypt exposes Encryptor::provider_for_encryption() so enterprise reporting can distinguish App-Bound Encryption from DPAPI, Remoting/Omaha installers write consent and security-key paths to the WOW6432Node view, installer::GetCurrentSetupPath() replaces ProductState::GetSetupPath() to avoid version-skewed setup.exe, macOS screen capture moves to SCContentSharingPicker on macOS 26.4+, and IsWindowOnCurrentVirtualDesktop() re-checks to stop false "other desktop" reports. (bbdf497) (47b55f8) (7bd31dd) (c6f9a60) (77cfb3f)
    WindowsmacOSUpdater

2026-11-17

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-17

Overview

Chromium main received 1,141 commits on 2026-11-17, about 952 of which touched areas relevant to Windows/macOS embedders (browser UI, extensions, networking, security, base/ui/testing infrastructure). The day contains two genuine breaks to stable public APIs: the removal of the size_t-based base::DiscardableMemoryAllocator interface and the removal of ContentBrowserClient::ShouldTryToUseExistingProcessHost(). Beyond those, the batch is dominated by enterprise capture protection, TLS client-certificate hardening, a macOS H.265 alpha-decoding out-of-bounds fix, Secure DNS flag removal, extension API additions (autofillPrivate Wallet offers, captureVisibleTab in standalone windows), and build/toolchain events (Bedrock test_support dep removal, libc++ roll, macOS Aperitif helper bundle consolidation) that carry downstream build and packaging risk. First commit: (ec5ac9a); last commit: (d99aa82).

Breaking API Changes

  • ⚠️size_t-based base::DiscardableMemoryAllocator API removed from the BASE_EXPORT interface: AllocateLockedDiscardableMemory(size_t), AllocateLockedDiscardableMemoryWithRetryOrDie(size_t, OnceClosure), GetBytesAllocated() and ClientDiscardableSharedMemoryManager::SetBytesAllocatedLimitForTesting() are deleted, while the base::ByteSize overloads and GetAllocatedSize() become pure virtual. Any embedder subclass overriding the old virtuals or calling the removed overloads fails to compile and must migrate to base::ByteSize. Follow-ups are test-only migrations. (f07f943)
    BaseStorage
  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient::ShouldTryToUseExistingProcessHost() removed. The virtual hook and all in-tree overrides (including ChromeContentBrowserClient) are deleted; its WebUI process-lock logic (WebUIConfigMap::GetProcessLockHost(url)) is now inlined into RenderProcessHostImpl::GetProcessHostForSiteInstance(), keyed on site_info.site_url(). Out-of-tree embedders overriding the hook no longer compile, and those relying on it to steer renderer-process reuse silently lose that control — any WebUI declaring a process-lock host now reuses an existing renderer process unconditionally. (d4c9d38)
    BrowserNavigation

Security & Privacy

  • Tab Share Protection now blocks a browser from capturing its own protected windows via getDisplayMedia(); OS-level screenshot exclusion previously did not stop self-capture of windows marked under ENTERPRISE_SCREENSHOT_PROTECTION. views::Widget gains an additive RegisterAllowScreenshotsChangedCallback(), and new public helpers GetWidgetFromWindowId() / IsWindowSharingBlockedByDataProtection() in desktop_capture_devices_util.h let custom pickers honor admin blocks; blocked sources render as "Blocked by your admin" instead of a thumbnail. (73689a6) (40b117b)
    SecurityEnterpriseMedia
  • TLS client-certificate hardening against buggy key providers. SSLClientSocketImpl now rejects Sign() returning OK with a 0-byte signature and an empty GetAlgorithmPreferences() locally (ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_SIGNATURE_FAILED, ERR_SSL_CLIENT_AUTH_NO_COMMON_ALGORITHMS), evicting the broken key from SSLClientAuthCache so the normal stale-key retry runs instead of sending an invalid CertificateVerify or falling back to BoringSSL's default algorithm list. Directly relevant to embedders shipping PKCS#11/CNG/CryptoTokenKit keys; new Net.SSLClientCertSignResult histograms and NetLog fields. (2895bec)
    NetworkSSLSecurity
  • H.265 auxiliary alpha-layer validation; HEVC alpha disabled in WebCodecs on macOS. Alpha-layer SPS/PPS/slice NALUs were forwarded to the accelerator unvalidated, and on Apple Silicon VideoToolbox the IOSurface is sized from the base-layer description while layer-1 dimensions write plane 2 — an out-of-bounds write. The decoder now compares base-vs-alpha configs and double-checks slices in VideoToolboxH265Accelerator::SubmitSlice(); VideoDecoderConfig::AlphaMode is plumbed in, so HEVC alpha is opaque in WebCodecs but preserved for <video>. (ab36475)
    MediaGPUmacOS
  • File System Access downgrades a hand-edited user ALLOW to ASK. GetReadGuardContentSetting()/GetWriteGuardContentSetting() route through a new GetGuardContentSetting() that returns CONTENT_SETTING_ASK when the value is ALLOW from SettingSource::kUser (Chrome UI and policy only ever write ASK/BLOCK), and a new CanRequestObjectPermission() override applies the same downgrade to ObjectPermissionContextBase grant paths. Persisted grants remain visible for ASK origins. (4ba5176)
    SecurityStorage
  • ORB kSniffMore bypass closed in Web Bundles. WebBundleURLLoaderFactory::SendResponseToLoader previously fell through orb::ResponseAnalyzer::Init's kSniffMore decision to kAllow, delivering inner responses without payload inspection. It now reads up to net::kMaxBytesToSniff from the bundle and evaluates via Sniff/HandleEndOfSniffableResponseBody, with pending reads aborted on error or destruction. (cdc4c4d)
    NetworkSecurity

Networking

  • Secure DNS bundled-settings flag removed and DoH fallback semantics pinned. kBundledSecuritySettingsSecureDnsV2 (expired in M150) is deleted along with its chrome://flags entry and metadata; StubResolverConfigReader::ShouldUseDohFallback() now returns false without consulting Safe Browsing (the //chrome/browser/net Safe Browsing dep is dropped), kDnsOverHttpsAutomaticModeFallbackToDoh is removed from the chrome.settingsPrivate allowlist, and GeneratedSecuritySettingsBundlePref writes only the profile-level bundle pref so local-state DoH preferences are no longer overwritten. Embedders observing DoH fallback state will see this change; the fallback plumbing itself is retained. (f6dabd3)
    NetworkPrivacy
  • HostCache capacity is now scoped per NetworkAnonymizationKey. max_entries applies per NAK inside an outer LRU of up to 32 active partitions (mirroring ConnectPredictorLRUCache and the CORS preflight cache), and HostCache::size() is added. Flooding the cache under a single origin can no longer evict other sites' entries, keeping DNS hit rates stable under hostile single-origin load. (c2a5dc3)
    NetworkPerformance
  • Expat rolled to R_2_9_0 with tag-based pinning. Build changes add lib/xcs.c, replace lib/xcsinc.c with lib/xcs.h, and drop XML_ATTR_INFO. Behaviorally, Expat ≥ 2.8.5 rejects XML declaration versions other than 1.x itself (XML_ERROR_XML_DECL), which changes the error surfaced by libjingle_xmpp's XML parser tests; applies to in-tree Windows/macOS/Android builds (Linux uses system expat). (58ff72c)
    NetworkBuild

Browser UI & Platform Behavior

  • BrowserView::GetContentsSize() contract restored. It returns the active ContentsWebView size again instead of the enclosing ContentsContainerView (which also hosts the NTP footer, docked DevTools and split-view borders), matching the documented BrowserWindow::GetContentsSize() semantics and fixing a session-restore DCHECK; SetContentsSize() now sizes the WebContents. Embedder code that sized or compared against the container must adapt. (a201e37)
    BrowserUI
  • WebUI toolbar keyboard navigation, focus and geometry fixes. A new ToolbarStateKey.KEYBOARD_NAVIGABLE plus a ToolbarView::RequestFocus() override route next/previous-pane shortcuts to the location bar instead of the last focused entry; WebUIToolbarWebView's constructor gains a pane parameter; OnPaneFocusRequested() records the request before SetPaneFocus() so F10/Alt focus keeps :focus-visible; the toolbar WebView now spans the full toolbar height so outset focus rings on avatar/app-menu chips are not clipped. (f04dd9e) (0259fcb) (87c5a59)
    UIBrowser
  • Windows and macOS input-path fixes. On Windows, browser UI and web contents share an HWND, so a second finger could move the cursor or drop the payload during DoDragDrop; touch drags are now bound to the initiating pointer ID, ignored from other touches, and cancelled on pointer cancellation or host destruction. On macOS, RenderWidgetHostViewCocoa now synthesizes the keyUp that AppKit drops during fullscreen Space animations (checking CGEventSourceKeyState), and the caps-lock CHECK in MacKeyCodeForWindowsKeyCode is demoted back to DCHECK. (c1ea2e4) (668d0e8) (d213c86)
    WindowsmacOSUI
  • chrome://policy gains a URL-synced filter and column selector. The search filter is bidirectionally synced to ?filter= via replaceState/popstate while preserving other query params, and a new Columns dropdown backed by policy_columns.ts (OptionalPolicyColumn: value/source/scope/level/status) toggles optional columns, which now render inside expanded rows; narrow (≤768px) viewports default to Policy value instead of Source. The C++ surface change is one localized string — no policy-provider API change — but the chrome://policy URL contract gains a documented query parameter. (54124cf)
    PolicyUI
  • WebUI omnibox modifier handling and popup dismissal aligned with Views. Ctrl+Enter combined with Shift/Alt/Cmd now both appends "www."/".com" and forwards the modifiers through OpenPopupSelection(), so dispositions are computed by ComputeOpenDispositionFromModifiersAndLogToUma() (Ctrl+Shift+Enter opens a new window) instead of Ctrl being consumed; the shared searchbox_mixin.ts is touched, so custom WebUI omnibox implementations should be re-verified. The popup searchbox also adds a capture-phase pointerdown listener that closes the unbounded dropdown when the press lands in its #inputWrapper shadow. (b609a63) (7a8922e)
    UIBrowser

Extensions, Autofill & Passwords

  • New chrome.autofillPrivate.getWalletDirectOfferList() extension API. Returns active Google Wallet direct offers (issuer name, short title, promo code, base::TimeFormatShortDate() expiration, Wallet link) backed by PaymentsDataManager::GetActiveAutofillPromoCodeOffers(). The change is additive for embedders, but note that GetActiveAutofillPromoCodeOffersForOrigin() now actually filters by origin and AutofillOfferData::IsActiveAndEligibleForOrigin() is replaced by IsActive() inside the payments data model. (2e4ede1)
    ExtensionsAutofillPayments
  • chrome.tabs.captureVisibleTab() now works in standalone windows (Document Picture-in-Picture and similar): TabsCaptureVisibleTabFunction::GetWebContentsForID() resolves the active WebContents through WindowController::GetActiveTab() when the tab strip is not editable, while editable-tab-list and page-capture permission checks are preserved. Separately, the Contextual Tasks component extension disables Mojo message-ID scrambling (scramble_message_ids = false) and bumps its manifest to 1.1, fixing VALIDATION_ERROR_MESSAGE_HEADER_UNKNOWN_METHOD renderer kills when a persisted MV3 worker outlives a Chrome build bump. (17a9345) (9c4ebce)
    ExtensionsBrowser
  • Extension fixes for enterprise fleets and search-override dialogs. ExtensionService::Init() now calls updater_->Start() before CheckManagementPolicy(), fixing a release-mode CHECK(alive_) crash on managed Windows/macOS profiles where an installed extension was disabled solely by the enterprise minimum_version_required policy. The "search overridden" dialog now resolves the correct regional engine through TemplateURLPrepopulateData::ResolverFactory, fixing wrong engine name and icon for Yahoo regional subdomains and Yandex country domains. (81e5baa) (98ceba9)
    ExtensionsPolicy
  • Password manager sharing and credential-offer correctness. skip_zero_click is now enforced for shared logins — LoginDatabaseAsyncHelper applies MergeLocalSkipZeroClick on reads and local writes, and CredentialManagerImpl::SendPasswordForm no longer clears it before the sharing notification is shown. Remote-actor credential sharing filters out blocked-by-user, non-HTML, federated and empty-password entries and dedupes with password_manager_util::FindBestMatches(), fixing duplicate chooser entries. (9e7a9e5) (29ad346)
    PasswordManagerAutofill

Base, Build & Performance

  • "Bedrock" removal of //chrome/test:test_support transitive deps. Four coordinated CLs replace the umbrella dep with direct, granular deps across chrome/{app,common,renderer,services,test} and mirror the same feature guards (enable_extensions_core, safe_browsing_mode, enable_pdf); public headers such as read_anything_util.h, instant_types.h and bound_session_request_throttled_handler.h move to //chrome/common, and extension_test_util.h gets an explicit visibility allowlist. Any downstream BUILD file that silently inherited headers through test_support will break at GN generation or compile time — the most likely immediate breakage for embedders. (4249810) (7ccf846) (d38449b) (6e4b815)
    BuildTesting
  • libc++ rolled 43 upstream revisions (64f64c14 → d0731bce). Items with downstream build/ABI consequence: the libdispatch and std_thread PSTL backends are removed (statpart becomes unconditional when threading is enabled), vcruntime_new is re-exported from std.new.nothrow_t on Windows for <__pstl/backends/statpart/decoupled_lookback.h>, and all Abseil .def symbol files are regenerated — relevant to Windows component builds and thin-link boundaries. Revert-on-breakage applies; treated as the batch's largest toolchain surface. (0403d33)
    BuildBase
  • macOS Aperitif helpers become the default. With the field trial complete, the (Aperitif), (Aperitif Renderer), (Aperitif GPU) and (Aperitif Alerts) helper app bundles and kAperitifHelpers are removed; all helper executables link libaperitif.dylib, chrome_exe_main_mac.cc is replaced by a .c entry point, and GetChildProcessPath() always uses kMacHelperSuffixAlerts. chrome/installer/mac/signing/parts.py drops four CodeSignedProduct entries, so downstream macOS signing/packaging pipelines enumerating helper bundles by name must be updated. (46d5f10)
    macOSBuildInfra
  • Memory-pressure reporting moved to free functions; Windows polling restored to 5 s. base::SetMemoryPressureLevel() and SetMemoryPressureLevelFromAnyThread() are added, the internal MemoryPressureSource static is removed, and producers (WebView, PartitionAlloc, Blink, plus RenderProcessHostImpl/BrowserChildProcessHostImpl, which no longer inherit base::MemoryPressureListener) subscribe via MemoryPressureSource; the deprecated listener API remains for compatibility. AvailableMemoryMonitor::kPollInterval becomes a public constant set to 5 s on Windows (2 s elsewhere), restoring the pre-migration cadence and reducing idle UI-thread wakeups and urgent tab discards without more foreground OOMs. (6e932ef) (82caf5f) (0b386a2) (5b6ef7c)
    BasePerformanceWindows
  • Background tab loads deferred while a visible page is loading. BackgroundTabLoadingPolicy::GetMaxNewTabLoads() now returns no background slots while any visible page is in kLoading/kLoadedBusy, capped at 15 s per window by kMaxVisibleLoadingDeferralTimeout, behind kDeferBackgroundTabLoadsWhileVisiblePageLoads. Measured 5-tab --restore-last-session gains: FirstWebContents.NonEmptyPaint3 −68 ms Win10 / −45 ms Linux / −12 ms Mac, FirstPaint −20 ms Win10. (6ec019e)
    PerformanceTabsBrowser
  • CreateGpuFenceForSyncTokens() now fences writes from any graphics API. The implementation begins and ends a GL read access on each shared image after the SyncToken waits, so the service-side representation waits on Dawn/WebGPU write fences, not just GL work. The four render loops (OpenXR, ARCore, Cardboard) now pass a new gpu::SharedImageFenceHelper instead of GLES2Interface — a signature change in gpu/command_buffer/client/client_shared_image.h. Per-frame fence cost drops from 0.27–0.40 ms to 0.07–0.11 ms and a visible eye-lag race under XRGPUBinding is gone. (23b4e53)
    GPUXRPerformance

2026-11-16

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-16

Overview

On 2026-11-16 the main branch received 1067 commits, of which 855 were relevant to Chromium embedders. The day's dominant theme is public-API churn: PolicyMap values became immutable, RenderProcessHost gained a pure-virtual startup-timings API, WebUIConfigMap::GetRegisteredConfig() was removed, and several smaller stable signatures changed. Alongside that, there are meaningful security hardening changes to File System Access, FedCM and extension MojoJS scoping, plus measurable performance wins in ui/views hit-testing and SimpleCache mass-doom handling. Range: (0f21023) → (a6cafef).

Breaking Embedder API Changes

  • ⚠️BREAKING: PolicyMap::Entry now stores scoped_refptr<const base::RefCountedData<base::Value>> and the mutable accessors are removed, not deprecated — PolicyMap::GetMutableValue(), GetMutableValueUnsafe(), and the non-const Entry::value(base::Value::Type) / Entry::value_unsafe() overloads. Out-of-tree policy providers and handlers must migrate to clone → mutate clone → Entry::set_value(). Pays for itself with ~6.0 MiB RAM, ~136 ms warm-start and ~326 ms cold-CBCM CPU per additional profile. (b760e58)
    PolicyBase
  • ⚠️BREAKING: content/public/browser/render_process_host.h gains a public RenderProcessHost::StartupTimings struct and a new pure virtual GetStartupTimings() const. Every out-of-tree subclass or mock of RenderProcessHost fails to compile until it implements the method — in-tree MockRenderProcessHost had to be patched in the same CL. Timestamps are plumbed from ChildProcessLauncherHelper/ChildProcessLauncher for InitialWebUI startup UKM. (d82800b)
    BrowserPerformanceTesting
  • ⚠️BREAKING: WebUIConfigMap::GetRegisteredConfig(const GURL&) is deleted from content/public/browser/webui_config_map.h; the old FindConfig() is renamed to GetRegisteredConfig() and made private. The replacement surface is a narrower GetProcessLockHost() returning std::optional<std::string_view>. Embedders doing BrowserContext-independent WebUI process-model decisions must migrate. (a9d5c36)
    UIBrowser
  • ⚠️BREAKING: content::PushMessagingService::Unsubscribe() loses its const std::string& sender_id parameter (pure virtual on a CONTENT_EXPORT interface; the Service Worker-database read of kPushSenderIdServiceWorkerKey is deleted with it), and the base::LinkNode / base::LinkedList compatibility aliases are removed from base/containers/linked_list.h. Both are clean removals — in-tree callers already migrated, out-of-tree code will not compile. (195cace) (349575a)
    NotificationsServiceWorkerBase
  • ⚠️BREAKING (source compatibility): WebContents::StartPrerendering() gains a required trailing navigation_ui_data argument with no default, so every call site must be updated; content::NavigationUIData simultaneously gains the overridable PopulateFromNavigationHandle(NavigationHandle&) (called before DidStartNavigation()) and CloneForNewNavigation(). Stated to be behavior-preserving, so a rebuild plus call-site edits suffices. (d757f4b)
    NavigationBrowser
  • ⚠️BREAKING: l10n_util::GetDisplayNameForCountry() now takes const base::i18n::LanguageTag& instead of std::string_view — no implicit conversion remains, the empty-string sentinel becomes LanguageTag("und"), and the en-US fallback moved to callers (an unparseable locale now yields no country name at all). In the same vein, OptimizationGuideDecider::RegisterOptimizationTypes() moves to OptimizationTypeSet by value rather than const std::vector<>&, invalidating every override, mock and call site. (a84a9f8) (8e94b32)
    I18nAutofillAI

Security & Privacy

  • Seven File System Access prefs (extended-permission exceptions and defaults, chooser data, read/write guards) are registered in kTrackedPrefs with ENFORCE_ON_LOAD + TRACKING_STRATEGY_ATOMIC, so hand-editing Preferences in plain text can no longer grant persistent FSA permission. Because existing values are not migrated into Secure Preferences, all existing FSA grants, guard exceptions and defaults are reset once on upgrade on Windows/macOS and users are re-prompted; this is intentional since forged and legitimate values are indistinguishable. (635d0c5)
    SecurityStorageProfiles
  • File System Access grant handling hardened three ways: move-overwrite on case-insensitive filesystems now invalidates case-variant destination grants in both active and persisted permission maps (previously a case-alias handle retained read access), move()/rename() re-validate that the on-disk entry still matches the handle type under the exclusive move locks (closing a file/directory type-confusion hole), and FileChooserImpl now rejects kOpenDirectory from the renderer rather than hitting NOTREACHED() — a deterministic browser-process crash for a compromised renderer. (8a370d8) (36a0f18) (88ba2de)
    SecurityWindowsStorage
  • FedCM popups and links now use an opaque initiator_origin on desktop (behind the default-enabled kFedCmOpaqueInitiatorOrigin kill switch), matching the spec's *fresh top-level traversable* model. Observable side effects for IdPs: Sec-Fetch-Site becomes cross-site instead of none, and the first request no longer carries SameSite=Strict cookies across a 301 redirect. Android has behaved this way since 2023 via Custom Tabs. (f4cb785)
    SecurityNetworkPrivacy
  • A cluster of leak/crash hardening fixes: Reporting API crash stacks now redact cross-origin no-CORS script frames (previously only extension URLs were filtered), Safe Browsing no longer leaks resource.url into the tab's pending allowlist across cross-host redirect chains or view-source: URLs, FIDO HID payloads above kHidMaxMessageSize transition to kMsgError instead of hitting a DCHECK or an empty optional, and the Windows meta-installer delay-loads secur32.dll to close a DLL-hijack surface. (d11f5a9) (6d328ae) (8542332) (0a0420d)
    SecurityPrivacyWindows

Extensions

  • events.addRules / getRules / removeRules are now reachable only from privileged extension contexts: _api_features.json moves the internal events feature from "contexts": "all" + "matches": ["<all_urls>"] to "contexts": ["privileged_extension"], and declarative_api.cc now validates a non-null Extension*, the privileged context, and web_view_instance_id, replaces prefix matching with an exact declarative-API allowlist, and rejects frameless / Service Worker / non-webview-permissioned calls. Content scripts or non-privileged frames using these calls break. (50bbede)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • MojoJS in extension frames is scoped to the extension's registered interfaces: each MojoJS-enabled extension document gets a dedicated ExtensionFrameInterfaceBroker (DocumentUserData, bound at commit) instead of RenderFrameHost::EnableMojoJsBindings(). Calling Mojo.bindInterface() for anything outside the extension's ExtensionMojoBinderProvider — including process-scoped interfaces — returns a bad message and terminates the renderer. Sandboxed extension pages and opaque-origin iframes get neither MojoJS nor a broker. (efdfb50)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Extension surface fixes: a use-after-free when a window closes with a pending chrome.action.openPopup() is fixed (the WebUI toolbar wrapper now stops observing first, then cancels the pending popup so openPopup() rejects instead of hanging), and chrome.developerPrivate.ExtensionInfo gains a required isolatedModeAccessControlledByPolicy field that consumers must populate — chrome://extensions uses it to lock the incognito toggle when policy mandates isolated mode. (b93f4e6) (4fb4e7f)
    ExtensionsUI

Networking & Service Workers

  • Network-stack hardening and QUIC groundwork: HostResolverManager::Job::UpdatePriority() no longer clears a re-entrantly replaced handle_ (use-after-free in the dispatcher), PAC ProxyResolverV8::Context lifetime no longer depends on v8::External identity inside the sandbox (never-reused numeric IDs resolved under the shared isolate's v8::Locker), QUIC sessions receive the resolving connection's fallback IPv4 address so IPv6→IPv4 migration works on v4-only networks, and PosixUdpEmulatedConnect skips the OS connect(). New Net.QuicSession.StartupLocalAddressCheck telemetry with no behavior change. (1c600d8) (36ff522) (4899545) (82886b8) (7ac0469)
    NetworkSecurity
  • Cross-Origin-Storage-Allow-Origin (WICG §7) is implemented: write target origins above the header's ceiling are dropped with a console warning, and workers inherit their creator's ceiling at creation time. Separately, the Storage Access API status is now plumbed through SharedWorkerHost → SharedWorkerFactory → SharedWorkerGlobalScope::GetStorageAccessApiStatus(), fixing SameSite=None cookie attachment for workers created via StorageAccessHandle.SharedWorker() (previously excluded with EXCLUDE_THIRD_PARTY_PHASEOUT). (f118c8d) (fb02859)
    NetworkStorageServiceWorker
  • SimpleCache mass-doom no longer stalls new operations: DoomEntries() feeds hashes from a queue shared with the backend, and when an operation waits on a hash that hash is moved to the front with its waiters released as soon as its *own* files are deleted rather than after the whole batch. CreateEntry() plus first WriteData() for the last hash of a 20,000-entry batch drops from 5–8 s to ~35 ms, with identical results and no cache-type restrictions. (933d168)
    NetworkPerformanceStorage

Browser UI & User-Visible Behavior (Windows/macOS)

  • Omnibox and bubble-anchoring correctness: WebUI omnibox ctrl+enter .com expansion now requires ctrl to have been pressed inside the omnibox (a ctrl consumed by ctrl+L/ctrl+V no longer triggers it — a user-visible change to a shipped shortcut), the Full WebUI omnibox popup stays aligned when an ancestor moves the location bar, the Windows WebUI omnibox now tracks CJK input-locale changes like the Views omnibox, and the popup visual-state callback is posted rather than run inline (fixing a !handle_.pending_association() CHECK). Sign-in / AI-mode / profile bubbles resolve overflowed WebUI anchors through RunWhenVisible() and async TrackedElement tracking instead of a stale anchor. (90add2f) (f76702a) (cbdafbb) (936c2ed) (5df4883) (a1c8d97)
    UIBrowserWindows
  • macOS content-fullscreen exit no longer hides Chrome UI (notably the vertical tab strip) for the whole transition: a new idempotent FullscreenController::WindowFullscreenStateChanging() is called from BrowserView::FullscreenStateChanging() under IS_MAC, clearing toggled_into_fullscreen_ and resetting extension_url_ before AppKit's relayout runs. Also: detached collapsed tab groups now expand around their active tab in the new window, and infobars switch to LINEAR_OUT_SLOW_IN / FAST_OUT_LINEAR_IN motion (reduced-motion still honored). (03c36cd) (438c35b) (6240d8d)
    macOSUITabs
  • The download bubble now anchors to the browser containing the inspected tab rather than an undocked DevTools toolbar, BubbleDialogDelegate repositions open bubbles when a non-Views (TrackedElement, e.g. WebUI) anchor moves, BrowserView::ShowInactive() joins the InitialWebUI deferral path so unfocused extension windows report ShowRequestedToFirstPaint2, and GlicKeyedService::CloseAllForLockedFullscreen() tears down every Glic embedder on locked fullscreen with a new GlicInvokeError::kLockedFullscreen. (c36a013) (e947f3f) (30e50d3) (624d713)
    UIDownloadsAI

Performance

  • View::ConvertPointToTarget() / ConvertRectToTarget() gain an O(1) fast path for the direct, layerless-child case instead of walking both views to the root applying gfx::Transforms and GetMirroredX() at every ancestor. Measured 440 ms → 190 ms UI-thread CPU while sweeping the pointer down a 900-item bookmark-bar overflow menu; hot for event targeting, tooltip lookup, layout and painting. Worth regression-watching for mirroring and rounding. (1710234)
    UIPerformanceCompositor
  • Memory and CPU wins in infrastructure: the updater's UpdateEndEvent now records an update state only when it differs from the last one, eliminating tens of thousands of per-16-KiB DOWNLOADING entries that produced MiB-scale serializations and updater-service OOMs; macOS Mojo caches voucher FeatureList values per ChannelMac instead of per received message; and grit compresses .pak resources concurrently via a thread pool with byte-identical output. (c8bebd4) (5875743) (82a6e7c)
    UpdaterNetworkBuild

Enterprise & Policy

  • New SearchFromDesktopEnabled policy (boolean, dynamic_refresh, recommendable) mapped to Local State omnibox_everywhere.enabled, listed under future_on so Beta/Stable only honor it with EnableExperimentalPolicies. Shipped with runtime hardening: the Omnibox Everywhere widget and its WebUI are torn down when the pref flips off, --omnibox-everywhere is ignored when the feature is disabled/unavailable (both on cold start and with Chrome already running), and user-set false background_mode / launch_on_startup prefs are cleared when policy enforces the setting. (6895a95)
    EnterprisePolicyBrowser
  • Other enterprise-surface additions: a new IsolatedModeUserInstalledExtensionsSettings policy (0=EnabledByDefault, 1=DisabledByDefault, 2=Blocked) wired into extensions.isolated_mode_user_installed_extensions_settings, chrome://policy now serves extension policies over Mojo under kPolicyPageMojoMigration (previously silently omitted), policy reporting and connectors read NetworkNameCache instead of calling net::GetWifiSSID() synchronously on the UI thread (multi-minute hangs on Windows 11 24H2+), and Windows activity reporting stops treating a per-user Azure AD workplace join as an externally managed machine. (011b035) (ba6bc54) (c2b452e) (ff5d2c2)
    EnterprisePolicyWindows

DevTools

  • CDP attribution and worker sessions: Target.createTarget (via a new ChromeDevToolsManagerDelegate::OnTargetCreated() hook) and /json/new targets are now attributed to the originating CDP client for enterprise reporting, including external Pipe/WebSocket sessions attaching to the root browser target. 2026-11-15

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-15

Overview

Analyzed 40 commits spanning refs/heads/main from (c416367) (first reviewed) through (f02b8ad) (last reviewed), with the range anchored by (8f11b54) and the head commit (c6cefae). The batch is dominated by networking work (proxy hardening, DNS/connection tuning defaults, QUIC IPv6-to-IPv4 migration plumbing), browser UI and extensions changes, and build-system maintenance. No confirmed MAJOR breaking changes to stable embedder-facing public APIs were found, though two items require downstream attention: a public Blink virtual renamed on WebLocalFrameClient/ChromeClient ((3992ada)) and upcoming GN enforcement of public_deps for generated headers ((9cc30ff)). Test-only, mechanical, localization, and non-Windows/macOS platform changes were largely filtered out.

Networking: Proxy & Connection Security

  • Proxy port restriction and HTTP/0.9 rejection are now enabled by default. Proxy endpoints are validated against IsPortAllowedForScheme() in HttpStreamFactory::Job::DoStart() (with defense-in-depth checks in HttpProxyConnectJob, the QUIC proxy job, and SocksConnectJob), failing with ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED so normal proxy fallback applies. Statusless HTTP/0.9 and legacy Shoutcast ICY 200 responses relayed through a forward proxy are rejected with ERR_INVALID_HTTP_RESPONSE; HttpStreamParser gained an is_for_get_to_http_proxy parameter threaded through HttpBasicState and HttpProxyClientSocket. New public helpers net::IsProxyPortAllowed() and net::IsProxyChainPortAllowed() were added to net/base/port_util.h. Both behaviors are reversible via the kRestrictProxyPorts and kRejectHttp09FromHttpProxy killswitches. (2e584f2)
    NetworkSecurity
  • ReportingUploaderImpl hardened against re-entrant teardown. Pending uploads are now removed from the tracking map *before* requests are canceled or completion callbacks run during shutdown and destruction, preventing use-after-free when a callback re-enters the uploader. No public API change. (ab4625b)
    NetworkSecurity

Networking: Performance Defaults & QUIC

  • Optimistic DNS and IPv6 fallback tuning enabled by default on non-Cronet builds. Turns on kOptimisticDnsForTcp (use_stale_connectors=true), kEnableIntermediateDnsResults (SortTransactionsIndividually=true), kAdjustIPv6FallbackTime (100 ms) and kIPv6FallbackBasedOnRTT (1.1x RTT multiplier). Because AAAA results are sorted individually, the combined A+AAAA RFC 6724 sort is skipped and HostCache entries now consistently place IPv6 endpoints ahead of IPv4. MockHostResolverBase::ResolveFromIPLiteralOrCache now permits fresh cache hits under STALE_ALLOWED_WHILE_REFRESHING, matching HostResolverManager — embedder test harnesses relying on the old mock behavior will see differences. (827b566)
    NetworkPerformanceTesting
  • IPv6-to-IPv4 QUIC connection migration plumbing landed behind kEnableQuicV6ToV4Migration (disabled by default). Adds QuicMigrationAttemptContext and migration logic in QuicChromiumClientSession, with the fallback IPv4 address threaded from DNS resolution through QuicSessionAttempt, QuicSessionPool::DirectJob, AsyncDnsJob and EndpointConnector. The address is currently approximated from the original A-record pending a real alternative-server-address spec, so expect interface churn in follow-ups; new migration histograms were added. (b5a6ded) (1276855) (b6987ca)
    NetworkPerformance
  • Updater's libcurl network fetcher extracted into its own files and hardened. Pure move out of network_fetcher_linux.cc into chrome/updater/net/network_fetcher_libcurl.{h,cc}, then extended with an optional explicit proxy (overrides proxy env, keeps CONNECT reply out of the header callback), redirect following (max 5) reporting the final status, response codes emitted for bodiless/chunked/redirect responses, cancellation via net::ERR_ABORTED per the components/update_client/network.h contract, and CURLOPT_NOSIGNAL plus connect/low-speed timeouts. macOS adoption as an alternative to NSURLSession for explicitly proxied downloads is planned. (b3429ca) (315f6ad)
    UpdaterNetwork

Embedder-Facing Blink Interfaces

  • ⚠️Console stack-trace requests moved from content.mojom.Frame into blink.mojom.LocalFrame, changing a public embedder virtual. SetWantErrorMessageStackTrace was removed from content.mojom.Frame and added to blink.mojom.LocalFrame; RenderFrameHostImpl now routes through GetAssociatedLocalFrame(). WebLocalFrameClient::ShouldReportDetailedMessageForSourceAndSeverity(ConsoleMessageLevel, const WebString&) is replaced by ShouldReportDetailedMessageForSource(const WebString&), with the severity check relocated into FrameConsole::ShouldReportDetailedMessage() using the new LocalFrame::WantErrorMessageStackTrace(). Out-of-tree WebLocalFrameClient and ChromeClient implementors must update their overrides. (3992ada)
    BlinkBrowser
  • ServiceWorker navigation preload lifetime crash fixed. NavigationPreloadRequest::OnReceiveRedirect() and OnComplete() now WeakPtr-guard the request before invoking OnNavigationPreloadComplete(), since resolving the preload response promise can synchronously execute script and destroy the worker context while the object is still on the stack. ServiceWorkerContextClient also null-checks context_ in OnNavigationPreloadError() and OnNavigationPreloadComplete(). (c6cefae)
    ServiceWorkerBlink

Extensions & Browser UI

  • chrome.tabs query decoupled from BrowserWindowInterface, with a highlighted default change. TabsQueryFunction::BuildTabList() and MatchesWindow() now iterate WindowControllerList via WindowController*, enabling tab enumeration for standalone WebContents; MatchesTab() tolerates null TabInterface and TabLifecycleUnitExternal. Behavior change: highlighted now defaults to true when TabInterface is null, in both ExtensionTabUtil::CreateTabObject() and TabsQueryFunction::MatchesTab(). (7c5cfc9)
    ExtensionsTabs
  • Server-driven TypeIconBadge rendered on the searchbox history icon. SuggestTemplateInfo.type_icon_badge was added to components/omnibox/browser/suggest_template_info.mojom and mapped in suggest_template_info_mojo_utils.cc, then drawn as a small badge dot in both the omnibox popup and Realbox via ui/webui/resources/cr_components/searchbox/searchbox_icon.{ts,css,html.ts}, with proxy plumbing in searchbox_browser_proxy.ts and composebox_proxy.ts. Additive mojom and TypeScript surface. (97d9c4c)
    BrowserUI
  • Web app window titles now use the localized IDS_WEB_APP_WITH_APP_TITLE template instead of a hard-coded "-" separator. Identical output for en-US, but title punctuation changes for other locales where translators chose an unspaced dash (e.g. en-GB). (fcb7784)

  • Digital Credentials requests for UserInfoCredential no longer show the caution interstitial hint. The VCT is added to CanVctValueBypassInterstitial alongside Phone Number Verification, so OpenID4VP SD-JWT DCQL requests for user profile claims return no UI warning. A deliberate privacy/UX policy relaxation in content/browser/digital_credentials/digital_identity_request_impl.cc. (c416367)
    PrivacyBrowser
  • Highlight and ::selection background colors corrected on Windows and macOS per CSS Color 4. Windows now only forces the system highlight color when actually using system colors, reusing the standard color resolution paths otherwise; macOS adds light-mode values for system-defined highlight colors. The corresponding WPTs migrated from content_shell to headless_shell now that they pass everywhere. User-visible theme color change on both target platforms. (a162341)
    CSSThemesWindowsmacOS

2026-11-14

Summarized by gemini-3.7-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-14

Overview

On 2026-11-14, Chromium development saw 322 total commits, of which 167 were relevant to Windows and macOS browser-level changes, ranging from network telemetry and enterprise isolation to base library optimizations and UI improvements. The changes span from commit (1eda7d4) to (38ccb8a).

Networking & Security

  • HttpNetworkTransaction now records proxy information and connection attempt records when stream setup completes via OnCertificateError or OnNeedsClientAuth, ensuring proper proxy attribution. (19b9c56)
  • Requests associated with pooled QUIC sessions receiving an HTTP/3 GOAWAY frame now surface an explicit retry code to enable automatic fallback on a new connection. (873a1c2)
  • Scoped Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) delete-on-exit cleanups now match strictly against session-only cookie origins instead of wiping all sessions across a profile. (c89b831)
  • Enterprise DLP clipboard copies are now tagged with their originating profile to prevent data leaks when the policy is applied at the profile level. (9de620b)
  • Implemented CRLSet binary search optimizations and modernized Merkle Tree Certificate path verification to use standard parsed X.509 CA certificates. (83b96e7) (dd76f4b)
  • Introduced NetworkNameCache to query Wi-Fi SSIDs off the UI thread asynchronously to avoid blocking device policy reporting on Windows. (86f91bf)

Browser UI & Desktop Experience

  • Omnibox popup views on macOS now observe visibility changes to re-synchronize bounds and re-request focus after native Space transitions. (58ce498)
  • Migrated Contextual Tasks ephemeral buttons out of standalone custom management and unified them into the PinnedToolbarActionsContainer framework. (1b1ff2a) (02c5baf) (a70a89d)
  • Refactored omnibox rich image updates to update row-scoped suggestion cells synchronously from the bitmap cache, avoiding full popup re-layouts. (31fd027)
  • Disallowed external drag operations on macOS for empty DropData payloads to prevent inadvertently dropping profile cards onto the Dock Trash. (9f08078)
  • Reverted Tab Search metrics migration back to chrome.metricsPrivate to prevent renderer histogram filtering rules from dropping top-chrome WebUI samples. (53a8d7d)

Base Libraries & Core Infrastructure

  • Enhanced FieldTrialAllocator with a leading atomic generation ID sequence number to let child processes detect stale variations state without breaking PMA disk compatibility. (f4cf0d5) (cb591fa)
  • Added webui_module_path equal to REPO_PATHS support to the Mojo TypeScript binding generator to produce cleaner repo-relative import statements. (08ad851)
  • Replaced runtime-initialized flat_map collections for command-to-action lookups with static constexpr fixed_flat_map tables to eliminate startup overhead. (8047795)
  • Modernized EventListenerMap lookups to return a base::span instead of a const ListenerList reference, reducing unnecessary empty list heap allocations. (581f233)
  • Implemented setting, clearing, and string formatting support for crash keys within the window.rust crash components with thread-safety wrappers. (cb809cf) (56ae826)

Media, Graphics & XR

  • Deferred WebGPU wire client disconnect logic onto a fresh task stack to prevent use-after-free crashes during context loss callbacks. (8f02a7f)
  • Added WebXR support for querying and controlling display refresh rates using the XR_FB_display_refresh_rate OpenXR extension. (172b31e)
  • Redesigned MediaRemoter to decouple remote playback control from tab mirroring, adding robust handling for in-flight cancelled offers. (9bfadb0) (d5b009a) (9d80e28)

2026-11-13

Summarized by deepseek-v4.1-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-11-13

Overview

On 2026-11-13, 1,123 commits landed on the Chromium main branch, of which roughly 889 were relevant to embedders and web developers working on Chromium-based projects. The day was dominated by three genuinely breaking changes to stable exported interfaces (DragSourceEndedAt, ApplicationLocaleStorage, and cc::TextureBacking/PaintImage), a cluster of high-impact security fixes (Connection-Allowlist bypass, clipboard policy bypass, WebOTP Permissions Policy enforcement, lookalike-interstitial under-triggering, a WebAuthn UAF), QUIC/alt-svc retuning, and continued Omnibox/Unified Tabstrip work. First commit: (ff58f9e); last commit: (076899f).

Breaking Changes & Public APIs

  • ⚠️BREAKING: content::RenderWidgetHost::DragSourceEndedAt() and content::WebContentsImpl::DragSourceEndedAt() now take const std::optional<gfx::PointF>& client/screen points instead of four floats / two points; widget.mojom's DragSourceEndedAt message and all Blink/Aura/Mac call sites were migrated. Out-of-tree overrides, callers, and mojom consumers must be rewritten; points must be both set or both omitted (CHECK_EQ enforces this). When a drag is rejected before a system drag session starts, coordinates are omitted so screen coordinates no longer leak to the renderer. (fc7461e)
    BrowserUI
  • ⚠️BREAKING: ApplicationLocaleStorage::Get(LocaleFormat)/Set(std::string), the public enum class LocaleFormat, and the cached tag_string_ are removed outright. Callers must migrate to GetTag()/SetTag(base::i18n::LanguageTag); there is no shim. This is a reland that already forced a downstream iOS migration, so any embedder reading the app locale as a raw string or requesting BCP47 formatting will fail to build. (92f0395)
    I18nBase
  • ⚠️BREAKING: cc::TextureBacking::readPixels() is now a pure virtual taking SkPixmap (previously SkImageInfo + raw buffer + row bytes + source origin), and cc::PaintImage::readPixels() is consolidated onto the same shape. Every out-of-tree TextureBacking subclass (e.g. mirrors of MailboxTextureBacking/VideoTextureBacking) must be rewritten; the reinterpret_as_srgb_ path now mutates a local SkPixmap copy. (2d7901a)
    CompositorGPU
  • Chrome-layer API removals requiring migration: TabStripModel::SetTabNeedsAttention() and TabChangeType::kAttentionOnly are deleted — callers must use TabUIHelper::From(tab)->SetNeedsAttention(), and TabDataObserver::OnTabUIChange() now always reports kAll. Also content::WebContents gains a new pure virtual ShouldIgnoreUnresponsiveRenderer(), so out-of-tree WebContents subclasses/mocks need an override. (7cabae4) (baf42d7)
    TabsBrowser

Security & Privacy

  • Connection-Allowlist bypass fixed: ClearNetworkRestrictions() erased a document's network_restrictions_id while a retained/cloned CorsURLLoaderFactory for that ID was still alive, and a missing ID means *unrestricted* — so subsequent requests and redirects escaped allowlist checks. NetworkContext now tracks live factories per ID and defers erase until the last one dies. (07baaf8)
    NetworkSecurity
  • Renderer no longer trusted for policy/permission decisions: ContentClipboardHostImpl::WriteBookmark() now runs IsClipboardCopyAllowedByPolicy() like every other Write*() handler (previously arbitrary URL+title could reach the OS clipboard regardless of enterprise Data Controls), and BindWebOTPService() now enforces the otp-credentials Permissions Policy in the browser, terminating the renderer with a new bad-message reason when disallowed. (6147d2f) (641160e)
    SecurityPrivacy
  • Lookalike interstitial under-triggering fixed on two independent axes: the action type is now computed per-URL rather than from the first hop gating the final URL, and domain-candidate matching is ranked by GetActionForMatchType() severity instead of returning the first heuristic hit (a weak eTLD+1 skeleton match could previously shadow a target-embedding match). Expect a measurable *increase* in interstitials and UKM/histogram discontinuities at landing. (50536ee) (974fb6b)
    SecurityNavigation
  • WebAuthn CTAP2 use-after-free in FidoHidDevice::Transition(): synchronous error callbacks (hairpinned into Ctap2DeviceOperation::Start() before token_ was assigned) could destroy the owning FidoTask and leave a dangling write. Error callbacks now post asynchronously. Remotely-influenced device I/O, so this is a real security fix. (517732d)
    SecurityBluetooth
  • Sandboxed-context data leaks closed: the CacheStorageSideDataWriter pipe is no longer handed to workers with opaque StorageKeys (nested workers of CSP-sandboxed workers no longer inherit the precursor origin), and BFCache now evicts the page when a dedicated worker is created after the frame went inactive instead of starting an unpaused worker (new kCreateDedicatedWorker disallow-activation reason). (7f00dca) (cad1925)
    SecurityServiceWorker

Networking

  • QUIC retry semantics change on all platforms: kInitialDelayForBrokenAlternativeService (10s) and kMaxDelayForBrokenAlternativeService (30m) are now on by default for non-Cronet builds, so a transient failure no longer parks QUIC for 300s/2 days. Separately, QuicHttpStream::IsConnectionReused() now caches whether a session ever created streams and treats preconnected sessions as reused, so HttpNetworkTransaction correctly retries ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED when a pooled session dies before InitializeStream(). (6fcb0b3) (4ce6260)
    Network
  • Legacy (pre-M55) push subscriptions forced onto InstanceID in PushMessagingServiceImpl: legacy app_id registrations without an InstanceID token are now invalidated (removed, getSubscription() returns null), unsubscribe drops legacy encryption keys, and Chrome stops sending the legacy GCM unregister request so old server-side registrations linger. Desktop-visible behavior change for anyone with very old push registrations. (f717ea8)
    NetworkNotifications
  • Randomized DNS job capacity: net::PrioritizedDispatcher gains Limits::additional_capacity and a SocketPoolExpandability state machine, TryAcquireSlot() replaces direct slot checks, and HostResolverManager supplies capacity whenever no HostResolverDispatch field-trial group is set — randomizing effective DNS concurrency above the soft cap (anti cross-site probing). PrioritizedDispatcher is NET_EXPORT_PRIVATE, but forks calling SetLimits() must not set the new field alongside reserved slots. (dfb549a)
    Network
  • Prototype surface teardown / signature change in base: the Reduce Accept-Language prototype is fully deleted — avail_language/content_language removed from network::mojom::ParsedHeaders, and the exported kReduceAcceptLanguage{,HTTP} feature symbols and CONTENT_EXPORT switches removed. base::ContainsEncodedBytes() in base/strings/escape.h now takes span<const unsigned char> instead of const std::set<unsigned char>&; out-of-tree callers must update. (d2f299e) (ee66e23) (08d91cd)
    NetworkBase
  • ServiceWorker synthetic responses corrected: a new capture_intercepted_headers param (default false) interposes a pass-through URLLoaderClient so eligible 2xx headers are cached even when every navigation hits an embedder preload handler; and registration lookup no longer creates synthetic registrations before consulting storage, so real workers with no/empty fetch handlers again bypass loader creation and keep embedder preload interception. (3276e85) (dafb559)
    ServiceWorkerNetwork

Browser UI & User-Visible Behavior

  • Full WebUI omnibox popup matures: losing views focus (including window deactivation) now blurs the omnibox and closes the popup; temporary previewed text reverts correctly on blur (has_temporary_text() check) and on Escape (initial selection, new RevertTemporaryText() mojom method); Ctrl-state is synced before both popup and searchbox key handlers; and Page.SetDefaultSearchProvider() gains an additive PlaceholderType enum plus search-engine name (external Mojo consumers of omnibox_popup.mojom must rebase). (99e52b0) (4bde73d) (7ff33da) (1400c52)
    UIBrowser
  • Unified Tabstrip correctness: fixed a null-deref crash when closing a tab with a custom theme (TabCollectionNode::RemoveChild destroyed the node synchronously while TabView survived for the close animation), and moving a tab to a new window now removes the view immediately instead of fading out (extending the TabCollectionObservers contract across 18 files); RTL reparenting bounds are now stored unmirrored. (a17a0d3) (5d92f63) (835a91d)
    TabsUI
  • chrome.windows.update() now works on non-browser windows: the target is derived from window_controller->window() (ui::BaseWindow) rather than requiring a non-null BrowserWindowInterface, enabling move/resize/focus of standalone Document Picture-in-Picture windows. Extensions that branched on failure for PiP will now take the success path; locked-fullscreen remains rejected for standalone windows. (206e512)
    ExtensionsUI
  • Menu/affordance visibility fixes: the "Other device tabs" app-menu entry is now omitted entirely (not shown empty/disabled) when signed out, history saving is disabled, the profile is OTR, or policy disallows tabs/history sync; the fullscreen "Press Esc to exit" toast is restored under silent pointer lock; and the Google API Keys infobar migration default is flipped to BrowserInfoBarManager. (907a135) (020bd38) (b849a37) (9fe2765)
    BrowserUISync
  • DevTools Storage cookie commands are now scoped to the target's partition instead of silently falling back to the default BrowserContext (which returned the last-used profile's cookies). Targets without a partition now fail with InternalError — no CDP schema change, but CDP consumers relying on the old cross-profile behavior will see different results and new errors. (19b0b4c)
    DevToolsStorage

Extensions

  • runtime.onExtensionLoaded lifecycle semantics corrected: an extension enabled during browser startup no longer fires two events ("startup" then "enable") — exactly one fires with reason "enable"; and reloading a *terminated packaged* extension now fires onExtensionLoaded with reason "reload" (previously nothing). Terminated unpacked extensions keep "update", matching the WECG precedence order. (e028002) (42144d7)
    Extensions
  • Additive extension API work: mimeHandler.setMimeHandlerOptions() gains null-reset semantics via a new [preserveNull] WebIDL attribute (null forgets the stored option so the manifest applies again; omitted members still no-op, so existing callers are unaffected), and autofillPrivate gains getLoyaltyCardList()/onLoyaltyCardsChanged with LoyaltyCardEntry. Histogram enums are appended, not renumbered. (015c6b4) (f52a2ca) (617c8e0)
    ExtensionsAutofill

Performance, Build & Platform

  • macOS foreground workgroup API (+6.2% M1 / +5.3% M5 Pro Speedometer 3, JetStream 3 neutral): new base/mac Workgroup/WorkgroupInterval types with retain/release, cross-process Mach send-right export/import, and TLS auto-leave on thread exit; SequenceManager::DoWork() and ThreadPool worker wakeups lazily join the foreground workgroup with a single acquire load. Purely additive public surface. (bb31afb)
    macOSBasePerformance
  • Python build actions repackaged as .pyz binaries: action_with_pydeps → python_action/python_binary() for GRIT, WebIDL (generate_bindings, build_web_idl_database, …) and several Android actions, with SISO configs updated and redundant PyYAML inputs dropped. Measured: generate_bindings 255.7 → 107.7 ms (−58%), grit 208.6 → 122.4 ms (−41%); public GN template names/args/outputs are unchanged. (5730621)
    BuildInfra
  • Image/graphics pipeline performance: zune-jpeg AVX2 backports (fused chroma upsampling + row color conversion, AVX2 IDCT) give ~17–22% faster RGBA decode on x86-64; ImageCache/ImageDataStoreDisk move buffers into shared storage instead of copying; and SurfaceAggregator drops duplicate AggregatedRenderPass entries (unioning damage) to eliminate redundant draws that affected Windows overlay promotion. (7f7b55c) (02233da) (5a1cbab)
    PerformanceCompositorGPU
  • Windows GPU/metrics fixes: WebGPU support metrics are re-enabled with per-adapter probing — only the active adapter LUID is enumerated (via RequestAdapterOptionsLUID), fixing the hybrid-laptop secondary-GPU wakeups and GPU-process hangs that had kept GPU.WebGPU.Support off since 2023. Also, Rust JPEG crates and PNG/deflate move to optimize_speed/opt-level 3, which is a binary-size change for embedders setting optimize_for_size. (c5b15a4) (076899f)
    WindowsGPUBuild
